Role Overview

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.
We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.
With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

Key Responsibilities
Product Vision and Strategy
Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

Product Execution and Delivery
Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

Using AI in How You Work
We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.
Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

Team Leadership
Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

Customer and Commercial Engagement
Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

Cross-Functional Alignment
Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.

Qualifications and Experience
12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

What you will do

You will join the Data Platform & Products Team and serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the engineering team, acting as the product owner for Data Engineering deliverables and owning requirements, governance, and the quality of what we deliver.

In practice, that means you will translate business intent into clear priorities, acceptance criteria, and delivery expectations so the team can build governed data products that are both technically sound and genuinely useful.

Gather and translate business requirements

Engage with stakeholders across Marketing Analytics, Product, Regulatory, Support, and Business teams to gather, analyse, and document analytical and compliance requirements.
Translate business needs into precise data product requirements and functional specifications that Data Engineers and the Data Architect can act on.
Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and review meetings to ensure alignment between business intent and technical delivery.

Define and govern data products and KPIs

Define and maintain business KPIs and metric definitions — specifying calculation logic, business context, and interpretation guidance — and ensure they are consistently applied across the organisation.
Support the creation and certification of data products and analytical datasets, ensuring they meet quality, lineage, and governance standards before being published for consumption.
Maintain business glossaries and data dictionaries that make data assets discoverable and understandable to non-technical users.
Promote standardisation of business metrics across teams, reducing conflicting definitions and improving trust in shared data.

Lead data governance and compliance activities

Support the implementation of data governance policies, standards, and practices across the data platform.
Maintain metadata, data lineage, and business classifications — working with tooling such as Microsoft Purview to ensure the data catalogue is accurate and up to date.
Assist with regulatory reporting requirements and compliance obligations, and support audit readiness activities.
Champion data stewardship across the organisation — helping data owners understand and fulfil their responsibilities.

Validate data quality and support adoption

Participate in data validation and acceptance testing for new and updated data products, ensuring delivered assets meet the requirements defined.
Support investigation of data quality issues reported by consumers, working with Data Engineers to diagnose and resolve them.
Drive adoption of certified data products and datasets across business teams — helping users understand what is available, how to use it, and why it is trustworthy.

Collaborate across functions

Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the technical Data Platform team — keeping both sides aligned on priorities, requirements, and delivery progress.
Work closely with the Data Architect on data modelling decisions to ensure physical models reflect business semantics correctly.
Support the Lead Data Analyst and Analyst team by ensuring the data products they consume are well-documented, governed, and fit for purpose.

What you bring

Experience

5+ years of experience in Systems Analysis, Product Owner, Business Analysis, Data Analysis, or Data Governance.
BE/B.Tech degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Experience working with analytics, reporting, or data platforms in a cross-functional environment.
Experience engaging with multiple business stakeholders — facilitating requirements sessions, managing expectations, and translating ambiguity into clear specifications.
Exposure to data governance programmes, metadata management, or compliance reporting environments.

Technical skills

SQL for data validation, exploration, and requirements verification
Data contracts (YAML-based) — authoring and maintaining data-contract.yml including schema definitions, KPI descriptions, column metadata, and governance attributes that feed Unity Catalog and downstream consumers
Unity Catalog — managing table and column descriptions, understanding catalog/schema/table hierarchy, and working with certified data product objects
Microsoft Purview — data cataloguing, metadata management, lineage tracking, and business classification
Power BI concepts — understanding how Gold layer data products are consumed in BI tools
Azure Monitor and Log Analytics (awareness) — understanding observability outputs for data quality and pipeline health discussions
Databricks notebooks (basic awareness) — ability to navigate and validate notebook outputs during data product acceptance testing
Data Warehousing concepts and dimensional modelling basics
Familiarity with data quality frameworks and lineage concepts

Personal competencies

You are a natural connector — you build trust with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and keep them aligned.
You are precise with definitions — you know that a poorly defined metric causes more damage than a missing one, and you push for clarity.
You are thorough in documentation — you treat well-written specs, glossaries, and governance records as deliverables, not afterthoughts.
You advocate for the data consumer — you think about how data products will be used and ensure they are discoverable, trustworthy, and well-explained.
You manage ambiguity well — you can take a loosely defined business question and turn it into a structured, actionable requirement.

Who we are

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

The role

At Axelerant, we believe the traditional handoff model , research to design to product to delivery , is no longer fit for purpose. You hold the story, the system, the design, and the sprint together , not as a coordinator, but as the person who owns all of it. You are not a designer who attends standups, and you are not a product owner who appreciates good UX. You are someone who does both, deeply, without losing fidelity in between. 

The work lives in overlapping loops , plan, prototype, calibrate, validate, ship, measure , and discovery feeds the backlog on a weekly cadence, not once at project kickoff. You will use AI tools to compress the concept-to-tested loop significantly, while knowing precisely where human judgment is irreplaceable.

Build and test coded or high-fidelity prototypes rapidly using AI-assisted tooling
Manage and groom the product backlog, balancing user needs, business goals, and delivery constraints

Identify where AI tooling accelerates the work and where human judgment must remain the deciding factor

What you bring

Proven experience spanning both UX design and product ownership , not adjacent exposure, but genuine depth in each

Fluency in systems-level thinking, including journey mapping, object modeling, and design system architecture 
Comfortable and credible in agile delivery contexts , backlog management, sprint ceremonies, and direct collaboration with engineering teams 
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping tools to accelerate the concept-to-tested loop 
Ability to write precise acceptance criteria that bridge design intent and development implementation
Track record of maintaining product coherence across fast-moving, iterative delivery cycles 
Clear communicator who can align stakeholders, advocate for users, and make prioritization trade-offs transparently

What you get

A role that is genuinely new , space to define and shape what great UXPO practice looks like 
Collaborative, supportive team environment at Axelerant 
Work at the frontier of AI-assisted product development with real ownership over outcomes

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on, data-fluent Technical Product Owner – Product Analytics & Telemetry to serve as the single source of truth for our product performance, user adoption, and platform utilization.

In this role, you won't just manage a backlog, you will dig directly into complex datasets across Databricks, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, WalkMe, and Datadog to quantify the real-world impact of our Jira initiatives. You will bridge the gap between engineering telemetry, product instrumentation, and business strategy, building the dashboards and executive narratives that dictate our roadmap investments.

Core Responsibilities

Multi-Source Telemetry Extraction: Query, blend, and analyze data across diverse infrastructure layers—including Databricks Delta Lake, Snowflake, relational databases (PostgreSQL), in-app workflow telemetry (WalkMe), and operational logs (Datadog).
Lakehouse Dashboards & Visualization: Architect and maintain high-performance Databricks SQL dashboards and visualizations to track cohort adoption, funnel drop-offs, feature utilization, and user retention.
Initiative Quantification & ROI: Map downstream user telemetry directly back to Jira initiatives and epics. Measure feature rollout velocity against actual adoption metrics to validate product bets.
Executive Storytelling & Roadmapping: Synthesize raw analytical outputs into structured, executive-level presentations that highlight adoption bottlenecks, quantify platform usage, and drive prioritization.
Telemetry Governance & Instrumentation: Partner with core engineering and data platform teams to define event taxonomies, tracking specifications, and governance standards, ensuring features launch with production-ready telemetry.
Exploratory Data Discovery: Conduct proactive cohort and behavioral analyses to discover untapped user behavior, navigation friction, and platform optimization opportunities.

Required Experience & Skills

3–6+ years of hands-on experience in Senior Product Analyst, Product Analytics, or Analytics Engineering within a modern SaaS/cloud environment.
Advanced SQL: Proven mastery of complex SQL (window functions, recursive CTEs, query optimization, handling semi-structured JSON payloads) across relational (PostgreSQL) and distributed data lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake).
Cross-System Data Fluency: Practical experience pulling or stitching disparate product data from application logs, clickstream tools, guidance software (WalkMe), and cloud storage (e.g., Azure Blob, S3).
Databricks Expertise: Strong familiarity working natively within the Databricks ecosystem (Databricks SQL, Lakeview dashboards, Delta tables).
Product Acumen & Agile Delivery: Solid understanding of modern product management frameworks, Jira project/initiative hierarchies, and KPI definitions (DAU/MAU, activation rates, cohort retention).
Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to build clean, persuasive decks and clearly present technical findings to non-technical leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Educational or applied background in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or Analytics Engineering.
Working knowledge of PySpark, Python for data manipulation, or dbt.
Experience operating within cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and understanding Delta Lake architecture.
Experience defining user event tracking frameworks from scratch (e.g., event naming conventions, schema contracts).

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Place of Posting - Bengaluru

Team : Economic Inclusion Program

About The/Nudge

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.

Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.

Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.

What are we solving for?

We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.

At The/Nudge Institute, We Have Been Piloting This Program For The Past 3 Years And Are Now Scaling It Across Multiple States. Our Purpose Is To Enable The Most Excluded Individuals To Become Contributing Members Of The Economy. We Will

Enable government to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to iterate on the program design to create impact at scale through our own implementations
Support more NGOs in adopting graduation approach by offering technical expertise and capacity building
Build evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Develop technology solutions that enable NGOs and governments to adopt and implement the program at scale & with quality

Position Overview

What are some of the principles/ approaches we use?

First principles thinking
Human centered design (thoughtful, action oriented, experimental & iterative process) with a gender lens (unbiased and reflective approach) 
Systems thinking (analytical, stakeholder oriented and holistic)
Strategic planning (result oriented, logical & coherent with clearly defined outcomes, grounded in current realities)

What will you do?

We are hiring an Associate Manager, Product Planning Feedback and Adoption to independently own planning, adoption and feedback workstreams across multiple state programs. The person will translate program priorities into measurable plans, ensure that product interventions and tools are used effectively, and build feedback loops that turn field experience into product and operating improvements.

This role combines hands-on program management with analytical and strategic ownership. The Associate Manager will work closely with State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights, Livelihood, Learning and Development, and program leadership. The role requires the ability to facilitate decisions, identify risks early and drive actions to closure with limited supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Planning and program visibility
Strengthen governance. Design weekly, fortnightly and monthly review rhythms that result in clear decisions, owners and next steps.
Strengthen collaboration between State Operation teams and Central Product teams through a regular cadence.
Adoption and data driven action
Own adoption across states. Lead the adoption of product interventions and tools from rollout through sustained and meaningful use.
Define meaningful metrics. Establish metric definitions, data sources, reporting frequency and data quality checks.
Interpret performance. Analyse trackers and dashboards, segment gaps by state, block, cohort or tool, and distinguish process, product and data issues.
Convert insights into action. Develop state-specific recommendations, align owners and timelines, and monitor whether interventions improve adoption.
Feedback systems and product improvement
Design end to end feedback cycles. Define the milestone, respondents, sampling approach, questions, scoring logic and success measures.
Ensure reliable data collection. Coordinate with state teams, monitor response quality and resolve collection gaps without compromising timelines.
Synthesize field evidence. Combine quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear product and process recommendations prioritised by impact, urgency and feasibility.
Close the feedback loop. Track accepted actions with owners and timelines, communicate decisions to stakeholders and verify closure.
Stakeholder leadership and communication
Anchor cross-functional forums. Set the agenda, prepare concise pre-reads, facilitate the discussion and keep reviews focused on decisions and actions.
Influence without authority. Build alignment across State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights and domain teams, and escalate dependencies with context and options.
Create leadership visibility. Prepare scorecards, reviews and written updates that explain progress, risks, underlying causes and specific asks.
Raise execution standards. Guide team members and partners on data discipline, meeting preparation, documentation and follow-through.
What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means that program plans and adoption metrics are trusted and used in reviews; risks are surfaced early with clear recovery plans; state and product teams receive recommendations that improve adoption; and field feedback leads to prioritised, tracked and communicated product or process improvements.

Who are we looking for in this role?

Experience and education
Relevant experience. 6+ years in program management, product operations, strategy and operations, implementation consulting or large-scale operations.
Independent ownership. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional, multi-location or multi-state workstreams from planning through closure.
Education. A postgraduate degree or MBA is preferred. Candidates with a bachelor's degree and strong relevant experience will also be considered.
Core capabilities:
Analytical fluency. Can define and interpret metrics, question data quality, identify patterns and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
Structured problem solving. Can break down ambiguous problems, identify root causes, evaluate options and make sound recommendations.
Stakeholder management. Can build credibility, navigate differing priorities and influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.
Executive communication. Can facilitate effective meetings and communicate complex information clearly in written and verbal formats.
Execution discipline. Is organized, detail-oriented and proactive about follow-ups, risks and escalation while managing multiple priorities.
Tools. Is proficient in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with dashboards and presentation tools.
Language and travel. Has strong written and spoken English and Hindi, and is willing to travel to and stay in rural program locations when required.
Good to have:
Sector experience. Exposure to livelihoods, social impact programs, government systems or large-scale field implementation.
Product adoption. Experience driving adoption of digital tools or process interventions across distributed teams.
Research and feedback. Experience with survey design, qualitative research, feedback synthesis or user research.
We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Manager, Product Development - EMV and Payment Technology

Overview

Mastercard delivers robust, high quality, and fully approved technology products that enable issuers, acquirers, and partners to bring secure and innovative payment solutions to market.

Within the Chip Engineering organization, the Product Approval Team plays a critical role in ensuring that these products—ranging from cardholder and acceptance devices to Wallet UIs, mobile applications, and back end systems—meet Mastercard standards and are delivered on time.

This role provides the opportunity to work globally across a wide spectrum of products, including device-based solutions, wearables, mobile payment applications, cloud based payment systems, transit solutions, and backend services.

________________________________________

Major Responsibilities

Operational Management

Lead and manage operations related to Mobile Payment Applications, Wallet UI, Wearables, and Back-End Server Approvals.
Ensure full compliance with Mastercard testing, branding, approval processes, and operational rules.
Oversee the execution of global approval processes and associated requirements for:
Wallet UI and Wearables
Merchant Presented QR (MPQR)
Cloud-Based Payments (MCBP)
Token Service Providers (TSP)
Trusted Service Managers (TSM) for SE/TEE-based solutions
Link with MDES, GVCP and PCI teams to ensure all pre-requisites are met
As a backup, manage operations related to Tap-on-phone Product Approvals


Vendor, Partner & Customer Engagement

Act as a primary interface with key external partners, vendors, developers, and customers.
Organize and lead weekly calls with stakeholders to track progress and resolve issues.
Manage modifications to vendor contracts or agreements, engaging legal when required.


Accredited Laboratory Management

Manage the Global Test Bench Identifier (GTBI) tool and ensure timely delivery to labs.


Data, Reporting & Process Automation

Maintain product approval databases and tracking files, proposing and implementing continuous improvement ideas.
Implement AI/Agent in our daily support activities and operations (when possible).
Visual Basic developments to automate workflows and accelerate approval operations.
Provide management with quarterly reports covering SLAs, approval volumes, KPIs, and key statistics.
Manage bi-weekly internal approved products report
Manage publications on Mastercard Connect
Contribute to communiqués outlining process changes and enhancements.


Regional Support

Support Mastercard Regional teams regarding product approval processes and product migration topics.


________________________________________

Required Skills & Experience

Education

University degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.


Professional Background

9+ years’ experience in quality assurance, project management, or business process engineering.
Industry exposure in one or more of the following: software development, financial services, telecom/mobile, e commerce.


Technical & Domain Expertise

Strong understanding of digital payment systems.
In depth knowledge of chip card technology and EMV specifications.
Familiarity with testing and approval methodologies is essential.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Access; Visual Basic development experience required.


Core Skills

Excellent analytical and business writing skills.
Strong project management capabilities with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and global stakeholder relationships.
Business acumen and ability to provide solutions while managing customer expectations.
Strong presentation and communication skills, with clarity in explaining concepts and processes.
Self motivated with a strong record of success in team-based environments.
Excellent command of English (Mandarin if possible), both spoken and written.


Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Looking for Product Lead who will own the technology-driven product lifecycle of the personal loan offering from system architecture and platform capability to launch, performance monitoring, and continuous optimisation. Drive automation and digitisation of the loan journey from onboarding, KYC, credit decisioning, e-sign, disbursal, and repayment to reduce manual intervention and improve TAT.

Commenda is building the agent for global legal and tax work. Teams use it to register entities, manage obligations, and stay compliant globally. Today that work requires additional headcount, local vendors, and disconnected systems.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn complex legal, tax, and operational work into reliable, agentic products. You’ll define how agents use company context, interpret requirements, take action, and involve people when judgment or approval is needed. You’ll work directly with customers, engineers, domain experts, and operations to build products that deliver compliance outcomes.

You’ll report to the Head of Product and start as a generalist. Over time, you may specialize in Transfer Pricing, Indirect Tax, or Entity Management. You’ll own your product roadmap, aligning it with business priorities and the company-wide roadmap.

What you’ll work on

Build agents that get compliance work done. Define how agents move from understanding a customer’s situation to planning and executing work. You’ll specify the context and tools they need, the actions they can take, and when they should ask for clarification, request approval, or escalate to an expert.

Make agent behavior measurable and reliable. Work with domain experts to define what correct behavior looks like, build evaluation datasets, and assess performance across real scenarios and edge cases. You’ll use traces, customer feedback, and expert corrections to identify failures and create feedback loops that continuously improve the product.

Turn regulatory complexity into product behavior. Help translate written requirements across jurisdictions into structured rules that capture applicability, conditions, exceptions, deadlines, and dependencies. You’ll define requirements and validate behavior with experts so our agents can determine what a customer needs to do and drive the next steps.

Build and improve workflows yourself. Work alongside operations and subject matter experts to understand how tasks are performed, then build workflows using Commenda’s workflow builder. You’ll identify where agents can take over work, where human review adds value, and how to make the overall process faster and more reliable.

Design how customers, service providers, and agents work together. Our products support customers buying services from Commenda, working with third-party providers, and handling work in-house. You’ll define responsibilities, permissions, handoffs, approvals, and visibility so each participant knows what needs to happen and can trust the work being done.

Talk to customers, prototype, and prioritize. Lead product interviews and feedback sessions, use Claude Code or Codex to prototype user journeys, and test ideas before committing engineering effort. You’ll combine customer insight, product analytics, and evaluation results to make roadmap decisions and measure whether what we ship improves outcomes.

What we’re looking for
At least two years of product management experience, with examples of products or workflows you’ve taken from an ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.
Hands-on experience with AI evaluations. You’ve defined what good output or behavior looks like, evaluated results against that standard, and used failures to guide improvements. You understand that a compelling demo is only the beginning of building a reliable AI product.
Advanced proficiency with Claude Code or Codex. These tools are part of how you work. You can independently build prototypes, explore product ideas, and test workflows. You don’t need to know how to code, but you need to communicate effectively with engineers and define precise requirements.
Strong judgment about agentic user experiences. You can reason through what an agent should do autonomously, where people need control, and how users should understand progress, review work, and recover when something goes wrong.
Exceptional spoken and written English and a confident customer presence. You can lead interviews, ask precise questions, explain complex ideas clearly, and earn customers’ trust.
Strong ownership and organizational skills. You can coordinate work across engineering, internal and external domain experts, operations, and customer success, keep decisions and dependencies clear, and drive unresolved issues to completion.
A willingness to get into the details. You’re comfortable learning how work actually happens, investigating edge cases, configuring workflows yourself, and validating results with experts.
Familiarity with Figma and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel. You use prototypes and data to understand behavior, test assumptions, and make product decisions.
Curiosity and rigor in complex domains. You’re interested in developing a working knowledge of legal, tax, and regulatory requirements, checking assumptions, and preserving the details that determine the right outcome.

Experience shipping a customer-facing AI or agentic product is a plus, as is experience with Braintrust or another AI evaluation and observability platform. A background in tax, accounting, entity management, or compliance is helpful but not required.

About the team

We’re an ambitious, intense team spread across Bangalore, San Francisco, and Seattle. We work like a sports team: we practice, challenge each other, and take shared responsibility for winning. People here move quickly, form their own opinions, and take on problems without waiting to be assigned them.

AI is part of how we build every day. You’ll work alongside engineers and domain experts who use agents to tackle complex work, experiment with new tools, and push what the product can do. We value curiosity, imagination, and the willingness to turn an unconventional idea into something customers can use.

You’ll have real ownership early, direct access to the people making decisions, and room to grow as you prove what you can take on.

Benefits
Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
Health insurance.
A monthly self-improvement stipend for learning, fitness, or other investments in your development.
Opportunities for international travel and collaboration with colleagues across our global offices.
A collaborative office environment and team events.

CDW is seeking a Product Manager to help define, build, launch, and continuously improve strategic solutions that solve meaningful customer business and technology challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end solution lifecycle—from customer discovery and solution definition through launch and ongoing enhancement—for one or more solutions within CDW’s Solutions portfolio.

This role partners closely with customers, Practice Areas, Engineering, AI teams, Delivery, Sales Enablement, Partner Management, and Solution Owners to develop scalable, repeatable offerings that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, AI, accelerators, and delivery methodologies.

Customer Discovery & Solution Definition

Define customer problem statements, target personas, use cases, business outcomes, and solution requirements through customer engagement and market research.

Solution Strategy & Roadmap

Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.

The Growth & Product Team

Where the GO of MetaGO happens!

This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.

You are not just shipping minor updates; you are building the entire ecosystem.

Here’s What You’ll Be Driving

• The AI Frontier: We are going full sci-fi. You will be building out next-level AI Health and Fitness Coaches, AI-driven sales flows, predictive AI alerts, content marketing, hyper-intelligent chatbots, human-like AI voice calls, and even tapping into AI video generation. Sab kuch smart, sab kuch next level.

• Omnichannel Tooling: Building the ultimate operating systems that make workflows totally makhan for every internal squad. You will own the CRM and tech for Acquisition, Sales, Customer Success and Support, Medical Operations, and Supply Chain Management.

• The MetaGO App: The daily companion keeping our members on track.

• The Meds Pipeline: The zero-friction logistics network getting meds from a prescription pad straight to a member’s doorstep.

• The Data Brain: The ultimate platform connecting every single consult, lab report, dose, and weigh-in.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience: Years are just a number. If you have worked in the right environment, you have what it takes. But yeah, we definitely want a strong product background.

• Leadership: You enjoy leading from the front and really value stakeholder relationships.

• Strategy: You can lay out a product vision and a multi-year strategy that gets everyone hyped to build.

• Execution: You know how to break down that big strategy into well-prioritized quarterly roadmaps and actually get things done.

• Data-Backed Decisions: You can ask the right questions and let the numbers guide your moves.

• Business Acumen: You are here to build a massive business, not just ship random product features.

• Technical Proficiency: You can sit with the engineering squad and actually influence the design and architecture.

• Fun Personality: People genuinely love working with you. Good vibes only.

• Superstar: That is exactly what we want you to become here at MetaGO.

Our current lineup covers medically supervised GLP-1 and non-GLP-1 programs, diagnostics, and coaching. But with the AI scale and massive product roadmap we are unlocking, honestly, picture abhi baaki hai mere dost :)

We are a fast-moving, high-energy crew that takes massive challenges head-on and owns them to the ground.

If you believe healthcare should start way before the panic sets in, and you want to build the tech that actually makes a dent, we need to talk.

Let’s build something epic together.

The *Deputy Vice President (DVP) – Strategic Product Core* is a critical leadership role responsible for defining and driving the foundational product ecosystem of the firm. You will oversee the "Core" product suite—including the trading engine interface, risk management integration, clearing/settlement workflows, and regulatory technology—ensuring the platform is scalable, resilient, and offers a superior execution experience for retail and institutional clients.

*Key Responsibilities*

*1. Product Strategy & Roadmap*

* Develop and execute a long-term vision for the core brokerage engine, aligning technical capabilities with business growth targets.
* Identify market trends in the fintech and broking space (e.g., fractional investing, zero-latency execution, AI-driven insights) to maintain a competitive edge.
* Prioritize features based on ROI, client feedback, and infrastructure requirements.

*2. Execution & Platform Excellence*

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of core trading products, from order management systems (OMS) to back-office integration.
* Collaborate with Engineering and QA to ensure *99.9% platform uptime* and seamless order execution during peak market volatility.
* Optimize the "Order-to-Settlement" flow to reduce latency and improve capital efficiency for the user.

* Work closely with the *Compliance and Risk* teams to ensure all product features adhere to SEBI/Exchange guidelines and internal risk mandates.
* Act as the bridge between business stakeholders (Sales, Marketing) and technical teams to translate market needs into functional requirements.

*4. Team Leadership*

* Mentor and lead a high-performing team of Product Managers and Business Analysts.
* Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making, using A/B testing and cohort analysis to validate product hypotheses.

*Required Skills & Qualifications*

* *Experience:* 10–15 years in Product Management, with at least 5 years specifically within the *Capital Markets or Fintech* domain.
* *Domain Expertise:* Deep understanding of Equity, F&O, Commodities, and Currency segments. Familiarity with FIX protocol, API trading, and depository (NSDL/CDSL) workflows is highly preferred.
* *Technical Literacy:* Ability to discuss system architecture, API documentation, and database logic with engineering leads.
* *Education:* MBA from a premier institute or a degree in Finance/Computer Science. CFA or FRM certifications are a significant plus.

*Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)*

* *Platform Reliability:* Reduction in technical debt and trade execution failures.
* *Market Share Growth:* Increase in Active Client Base and Average Daily Turnover (ADTO) through product improvements.
* *Time-to-Market:* Efficient delivery of regulatory-mandated updates and new feature rollouts.
* *Customer Satisfaction:* Improvement in Net Promoter Score (NPS) regarding platform stability and ease of use.

Map customer and consumer journeys to identify opportunities to improve engagement and impact at each touchpoint.
Prepare high-quality business reviews, brand reviews, leadership updates, and strategic presentations.

Use data analytics to inform business decisions, identify growth opportunities, and optimize marketing investments.
Support business case preparation, commercial planning, forecasting, and budget tracking for assigned brand activities.
Coordinate digital and social media campaign planning, rollout, and performance measurement in partnership with internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate effectively with Medical, Sales, Commercial Excellence, Market Access, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Supply Chain, and other relevant teams.
Manage agencies, vendors, and partners to ensure delivery of high-quality outputs on time and within budget.
Ensure all materials, programs, and communications comply with AbbVie policies, ethical standards, and applicable local regulations.
Monitor market, customer, and competitor developments to identify risks, opportunities, and strategic actions.
Contribute to franchise and portfolio-level planning with insights grounded in customer needs and market evidence.
Demonstrate strong stakeholder management and influence across a complex matrix environment.

Qualifications

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Business, or a related field preferred.
Relevant experience in brand management, product management, or marketing in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, aesthetics, medical devices, or a similarly regulated environment.
Proven experience in product life cycle management and new product launches.
Strong ability to build and execute marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
Experience in market research, insight generation, and commercial analysis.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to create compelling presentations and robust analyses.
Working understanding of digital marketing and social media campaign planning and execution.
Strong business acumen with experience supporting planning, forecasting, and business case development.
Demonstrated success working in a matrix organization and managing multiple stakeholders.

Additional Information

Core Competencies

Strategic thinking and business acumen
Customer-centric mindset
Analytical and data-driven decision-making
Execution excellence and accountability
Collaboration and cross-functional influence
Stakeholder management and relationship building
Adaptability and agility in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication and presentation skills
Innovation and continuous improvement mindset
Ethical judgment and integrity

Leadership Expectations

Demonstrate ownership, initiative, and sound judgment in managing the portfolio.
Act as a role model for AbbVie values through integrity, collaboration, and commitment to excellence.
Influence decisions through insight, credibility, and strong business acumen.
Build trust with internal and external stakeholders through clear communication and reliable delivery.
Contribute to a high-performance culture with a focus on results, accountability, and continuous learning.

Additional Requirements

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver to tight timelines.
Comfort operating in a dynamic, evolving business environment.
Strong storytelling ability for internal and external audiences.

Job Description: Edge Management Platform (EMP)

*Job Title:* Edge Management Platform (EMP)
*Job Function:* Technical Platforms & Infrastructure mandatory
*Experience:* Relevant experience in technical product management
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Work Location:* Bangalore

*Immediate joiners within 30 days preferred. *

1. Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong and customer-focused *Product Manager for an Edge Management Platform (EMP)* to drive the product strategy, roadmap, and evolution of a platform that simplifies application deployment and management across distributed infrastructure environments.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with technical platforms such as cloud infrastructure, virtualisation, hypervisors, Kubernetes, container platforms, or infrastructure management solutions.

Prior experience in Edge Computing is not mandatory. However, candidates must demonstrate strong technical platform understanding, sound product management capabilities, and the ability to translate complex infrastructure challenges into simple, scalable, and user-friendly product experiences.

The role requires a product owner who can make independent prioritisation decisions, understand customer needs, collaborate closely with engineering teams, and deliver measurable business and technical outcomes.

2. Key Responsibilities

* *Product Strategy & Roadmap:* Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and feature priorities in alignment with customer needs and business objectives.
* *Technical Platform Ownership:* Develop a strong understanding of the underlying infrastructure, including cloud platforms, hypervisors, Kubernetes, virtualisation, and application deployment technologies.
* *Customer Experience:* Identify opportunities to simplify application deployment, infrastructure management, monitoring, and operational workflows for application teams.
* *Self-Service & Automation:* Drive product capabilities such as self-service provisioning, API-based integrations, automated deployments, resource management, and lifecycle operations.
* *Product Prioritisation:* Evaluate competing requirements and balance new features against reliability, scalability, security, automation, and technical debt.
* *Engineering Collaboration:* Work closely with engineering, architecture, design, and operations teams to define requirements, evaluate dependencies, and guide implementation.
* *Stakeholder Management:* Gather and prioritise input from customers, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and other product teams.
* *Platform Reliability:* Ensure product decisions support operational visibility, failure handling, resilience, and consistent management across distributed environments.
* *Product Delivery & Outcomes:* Define success metrics, monitor adoption and performance, and use customer feedback and measurable results to improve the platform continuously.

3. Required Skills & QualificationsTechnical Skills

* 9+ years of experience
* Cloud platforms and infrastructure management.
* Virtualisation technologies and hypervisors.
* Kubernetes, containers, and orchestration platforms.
* Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) or Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).
* Application deployment, monitoring, provisioning, and lifecycle management.
* Distributed systems, APIs, and automation frameworks.
* Understanding of how application platforms interact with underlying infrastructure.
* Ability to explain technical concepts and platform capabilities in simple, business-oriented language.

Product Management Skills

* Demonstrated ownership of product strategy, roadmap, prioritisation, and product decisions.
* Experience translating user problems into product features, requirements, and capabilities.
* Ability to balance customer requests, engineering constraints, technical improvements, and business priorities.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience defining product success metrics and evaluating outcomes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will:

* Have worked as a Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, Platform Product Manager, or in a comparable product ownership role.
* Have hands-on exposure to infrastructure-related products or technically complex platforms.
* Demonstrate a clear understanding of platform users, their challenges, and the value delivered by the product.
* Show evidence of making product decisions rather than solely coordinating engineering delivery, managing sprints, or tracking project milestones.
* Be comfortable applying experience from cloud, Kubernetes, virtualisation, or infrastructure platforms to new problem spaces, including Edge Management.

*Note:* Direct Edge Computing experience is an advantage, not a mandatory requirement.

Pay: Up to ₹4,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

DESCRIPTION

An Amazon Now customer in India orders tomatoes and milk and gets them in 10 minutes. Behind that order, someone decided what to buy, how much, from whom and when. These products lasts only 1 to 3 days. Demand changes every hour. Get the tooling right and customers get fresh food with less waste. You will own the systems that make these calls.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap by working backward from customer needs, articulating clear problem statements, and aligning stakeholders across engineering, design, finance, and operations on priorities and trade-offs.
- Drive the full product lifecycle from ideation through launch and post-launch optimization, defining success criteria and key performance indicators, monitoring operational health, and iterating based on usage data and customer feedback.
- Collaborate across multiple functional areas to deliver for the customer, influencing without authority to build alignment among teams with different priorities and resolving competing demands through clear communication and sound judgment.
- Leverage data, customer research, and market analysis to inform product decisions, proactively seeking new insights from usage patterns, support tickets, and competitive trends to ensure the product stays aligned with evolving customer needs.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools and emerging technologies where appropriate to accelerate development cycles, improve decision-making, and unlock new forms of innovation within your product area.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Location: Bengaluru, HSR | Full-time | Level: L4 | Reports to: CPO / BU Head 
ABOUT FINKRAFT.AI 
Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months. 
The Hotel vertical is our primary growth unlock for the next 18 months. This PM owns it. 
THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING 
A corporate employee books a hotel through a TMC or GDS. The booking passes through a PMS like Opera Cloud. The invoice is generated by the hotel, sometimes routed through a Concur integration or a bank lodge card program. By the time the finance team tries to claim GST on that invoice, the corporate GSTIN is missing, the folio is incomplete, the tax breakdown is wrong, or the invoice never arrived. 
This happens at scale across every enterprise client Finkraft serves. Your job is to understand every node in that chain — hotel, PMS, GDS, OTA, TMC, Concur, bank, payment player — and build the product that fixes it. 
WHAT YOU WILL OWN IN 90 DAYS 
Full ecosystem map completed: every player in the hotel invoicing and GST chain documented — where data breaks, who owns the fix, and what Finkraft's integration surface is at each node. 
Field engagement calendar live: structured visit schedule across TMCs, hotel chains, corporates, and software companies — minimum 15 discovery meetings completed, findings structured into roadmap inputs. 
One PRD shipped to engineering: based on field findings and existing client pain, a product spec written, reviewed, and in active development. 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
Product Strategy and Roadmap 
Own the end-to-end product strategy for the Hotel vertical: what gets built, in what sequence, and why 
Define the roadmap based on enterprise client pain, ecosystem partner signals, and competitive landscape — not internal assumptions 
Present roadmap to leadership, Sales, and enterprise clients at QBRs; defend prioritisation decisions with data and customer evidence 
Track roadmap delivery against committed timelines; own the gap between what was promised and what shipped 
Field Ecosystem Engagement 
Conduct structured field meetings across the full hotel ecosystem: TMCs (BCD, CWT, FCM, SOTC), GDS providers (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), OTAs (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Expedia), hotel chains and revenue management teams, PMS vendors (Opera Cloud, IDS, Hotelogix), corporate travel managers, expense platform teams (Concur, Happay, Zoho Expense), banks (for lodge card and virtual card programs), and payment platforms (Razorpay, HDFC SmartPay, Mastercard CEP) 
Extract structured product intelligence from every field meeting: integration documentation, data flow maps, GSTIN handling gaps, invoice format standards, and API availability 
Convert field findings into product inputs within 5 business days of every meeting — not raw notes, structured inputs 
Ecosystem Integration Ownership 
Map data flow across the full chain: hotel PMS → GDS/OTA/TMC → Concur/expense tool → bank/payment → Finkraft → GST claim 
Identify where corporate GSTIN, folio data, and invoice tax breakdowns break at each handoff 
Define integration specifications for priority ecosystem partners; own the partner relationship through integration go-live 
Maintain a live integration roadmap: what's in production, what's in development, what's blocked and why 
PRD and Engineering Partnership 
Write clear, complete PRDs for every feature in development: problem statement, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics 
Partner with engineering through the full build cycle — not just handoff and review 
Attend standups, unblock decisions in real time, and accept or reject releases based on defined criteria 
Maintain a product backlog that engineering can execute against without PM involvement in every sprint decision 
Sales, BA, and CS Collaboration 
Feed qualified product intelligence to Sales: what integrations exist, what gaps remain, and what client use cases are unlocked by each roadmap item 
Work with Senior BAs on field observations — BA finds the problem, PM defines the fix 
Support enterprise client conversations on product capability, integration timelines, and roadmap commitments — own what you say in the room 
Partner with CS on rollout plans for new features: training, documentation, and client communication owned by PM, not CS 
Market and Regulatory Intelligence 
Track GST regulatory changes relevant to hotel invoicing: e-invoicing thresholds, folio compliance requirements, GSTIN transmission mandates 
Monitor hotel-tech landscape: new PMS entrants, GDS API changes, OTA invoicing policy shifts, Concur integration updates 
Bring competitive signals into roadmap prioritisation — what are enterprise clients being offered by alternatives? 



Requirements

Must Have

Has conducted field discovery meetings with external ecosystem partners — not just internal user interviews 
Working knowledge of corporate travel ecosystems: TMCs, GDS platforms, OTAs, PMS providers, and how they connect

About INDmoney
INDmoney is a personal finance super app that helps millions of Indians track, invest and grow their money in one place. Users invest in US stocks, Indian stocks, mutual funds, IPOs and fixed deposits, and manage credit cards, loans and net worth from a single app.
About the role
Every day, thousands of users tell us what’s broken — through support tickets, app reviews, call transcripts, chatbot logs and drop-off data. Most companies route these to a backlog. We want one person who owns them end to end.
You’ll pick up a consumer problem, find out why it’s happening, and ship the fix — whatever shape the fix takes. Some days that’s a one-line change to an order status screen. Some days it’s a new state in a backend workflow, a rewrite of a help-centre article, a new macro or lookup tool for our support reps, or a process change with Ops and Compliance. You decide what the right fix is, get it built (or build it), and verify the problem actually went away.
You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Operations and Compliance, and report directly to product leadership. Your scorecard is simple: fewer tickets, faster resolutions, fewer users stuck.
What you’ll do
Mine CRM tickets, call recordings, chatbot transcripts, Play Store/App Store reviews and product analytics funnels to find the problems worth solving, and size them.
Run root-cause analysis: trace a user complaint back through app state, API responses, backend workflows and ops processes to the actual failure point.
Spec and ship fixes across the full stack of the problem: frontend copy and UI states, backend status handling, retry/edge-case logic, ops workflows, help-centre content and internal tools for CS reps.
Write clear, plain-language user-facing copy for error states, status screens and help articles.
Build or improve tools for the support team: dashboards, lookup views, canned responses, escalation flows.
Close the loop: instrument fixes, watch ticket volumes and funnels, and confirm the problem is gone before moving on.
Flag patterns upstream — if the same class of issue keeps recurring, drive the structural fix with the relevant product or engineering owner.
What we’re looking for
2–8 years in product, operations, support engineering, solutions engineering or a similar role where you owned problems end to end.
Comfortable with SQL; you can pull your own data from a warehouse without waiting on anyone.
Strong systems thinking: you can read an API response, follow a state machine, and reason about why a payment, order or KYC step got stuck.
Able to write a crisp spec and a crisp help article — and know which one the problem needs.
Evidence of shipping: you can point to things you fixed and the metric that moved.
High ownership and low ego. You’d rather solve the problem than argue about whose problem it is.
Nice to have
Experience at a broker, fintech or consumer app in India — familiarity with SEBI/RBI flows (KYC, DDPI, settlements, pay-in/pay-out, corporate actions) is a plus.
Can read code or write basic scripts (Python/JS) to prototype a tool or debug a flow.
Hands-on with CRM/ticketing, issue-tracking and product analytics tools.
Experience building internal tools or agent-facing workflows.
Exposure to LLM/chatbot tooling for support automation.
Why join
Real impact, fast. Your fixes will reach millions of investors and show up in ticket volumes within weeks.
Ownership. You own the problem from complaint to resolution, with direct access to the founders and senior leadership.
Growth. Competitive compensation with ESOPs, a learning budget and a team that ships every week.
Breadth. You’ll touch product, engineering, ops, compliance and support in a single role — a rare vantage point on how a fintech actually runs.
Visibility. The problems you solve are the ones leadership hears about most. Good work here is seen.

About Easyship:

Easyship is a leading global shipping software and API platform trusted by 100,000+ eCommerce merchants to compare couriers, automate fulfilment, and simplify cross-border shipping, taxes and duties. A top-rated Shopify Certified Technology Provider, eBay preferred fulfilment partner, and Amazon preferred multi-channel integrator, Easyship is the G2 category leader (April 2026), offering 550+ courier services worldwide. We believe in accelerating borderless commerce through innovative solutions, and we're proud that brands of all sizes from small business to enterprise trust Easyship for all their shipping needs.

Who we’re looking for:

Easyship is a shipping technology platform that connects sellers and marketplaces to couriers. Beyond that, we also build and execute customized end-to-end shipping solutions for clients worldwide. These Logistics solutions can combine a number of partners and services, from global freight forwarding services to last-mile delivery.
We’re looking for an experienced Project manager with good knowledge of ecommerce shipping, warehousing & fulfillment to oversee the delivery of these projects for our clients. Own part of the Easyship product by defining solutions in line with the product vision and strategy, coordinating with the design and engineering teams, in order to constantly create value for our users.

What you additionally need to know:

This is a full-time, onsite role based in our Bengaluru (MG Road) office. The role follows UK collaboration hours (11:00AM–8:00PM IST) to support seamless cross-regional execution.

What you would be responsible for:

Owning the product strategy and roadmap for two squads: Finance (payments, billing, invoicing, fees and reconciliation) and Account Management (account lifecycle, verification, fraud and risk), with every roadmap item tied to a measurable business outcome.
Reducing the cost of taking payments: shape payment method mix (e.g. Pay by Bank), multi-currency settlement, payment provider migrations across regions, and systematically root-cause and reduce payment failures, disputes and chargebacks.
Growing revenue from the finance surface: fee and pricing structures, processing fees on chargeable items, reconciliation of taxes and duties adjustments, and accurate VAT/GST invoicing across every region we operate in.
Owning the end-to-end account lifecycle, from sign-up and verification to user roles, team permissions, account settings and closure, so that genuine customers get through with minimal friction and bad actors do not.
Defining and evolving fraud and risk controls across onboarding and payments, balancing loss prevention against conversion, in close partnership with Finance, Customer Experience and Compliance.
Partnering with Finance and Accounting, Customer Experience, Sales, Legal and Engineering to deliver scalable solutions, and act as the single product point of contact for anything touching money or accounts.
Establishing, monitoring and reporting on success metrics such as transaction cost as a percentage of GMV, payment success rate, dispute rate, revenue leakage, fraud losses, onboarding conversion and account-related support volume.
Prioritising ruthlessly across two squads: define the MVP, ship quickly, measure success or failure, and iterate.
Authoring and reviewing Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and Opportunity Assessments that clearly document trade-offs, edge cases, compliance and data considerations before they go to engineering.
Using AI tools hands-on in your own product workflow (discovery, analysis, PRD writing, data accuracy checks) and help raise the bar on AI adoption across the product team.
Acting as a senior voice in the PM team, raising the quality bar on PRDs and mentoring less experienced PMs.

You Might Be a Good Fit If…

You have 7+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years owning payments, billing or fintech products in B2B SaaS, marketplaces or eCommerce.
You have hands-on experience with payment service providers (e.g. Stripe, Adyen), local payment methods, multi-currency settlement, disputes and chargebacks, and payment reconciliation.
You have knowledge of account and identity products: KYC/KYB, role-based access control, and fraud detection or risk-scoring tooling.
You have an understanding of tax invoicing (VAT/GST) and the basics of revenue accounting, with a track record of working closely with Finance teams.
You have proven ability to move business metrics such as cost, revenue and loss rates, with examples you can quantify.
You have experience running more than one engineering squad or roadmap in parallel without losing depth on either.
You have strong analytical skills; comfortable pulling and interpreting data yourself (SQL or equivalent).
You have clear, structured written communication and the confidence to push back on engineering, stakeholders and leadership with evidence.
You have practical, demonstrable use of AI tools in your day-to-day product work.
You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance or related field preferred.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you.

Generous remuneration and stock units

Operating with significant autonomy, the PM4 leads cross‑functional teams across engineering, operations, supply chain, quality, marketing, and customer support to deliver products that meet performance, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and supportability targets. The PM4 influences portfolio‑level decisions, manages complex tradeoffs, and serves as a senior product leadership voice within EPG.

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy, Vision & Roadmap Ownership
Own and evolve the product vision and multi‑year roadmap for assigned etch products or platforms, integrating customer needs, market dynamics, and technology direction.
Lead roadmap alignment discussions with engineering, marketing, operations, and executive stakeholders.
Translate strategy into clear success criteria, program vision, and prioritized investment decisions.
Plan of Record (POR) & Program Accountability
Author, communicate, and govern the Plan of Record (POR) for major programs, options, and sustaining initiatives.
Hold cross‑functional teams accountable to committed deliverables, milestones, cost targets, and performance objectives.
Manage tradeoffs explicitly, balancing speed, risk, cost, and long‑term product health.
End‑to‑End Product Lifecycle Ownership
Accountable for delivery of a Whole Product that is:
Qualified and meets customer performance targets
Released into manufacturing with predictable cost and lead time
Supportable in the field with complete documentation, training, and spares readiness
Own product definition in Product Option Architecture (POA) and approve product changes.
Govern unreleased product execution, including build plans, material readiness, and release gating.
Customer & Market Leadership
Serve as a senior voice of the customer, engaging directly with key customers, account teams, and regional marketing.
Lead customer roadmap reviews, issue prioritization, and escalation alignment for critical accounts.
Ensure product decisions are grounded in customer value, competitive positioning, and commercial outcomes.
Cross‑Functional Leadership & Influence
Lead large, matrixed cross‑functional teams without direct authority.
Drive clarity, alignment, and decision‑making across engineering, operations, supply chain, quality, and service organizations.
Mentor and coach junior product managers, contributing to capability building within the product management function.

Innovate with Tether

About The Job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.
Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.
Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.
Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.
Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.
Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.
Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

Mandatory:

5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)
3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry
Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.
Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.
Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.
Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.
Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.
Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.
Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
