About The Job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.
Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.
Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.
Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.
Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.
Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.
Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.
Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.
Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.
Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.
Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.
Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.
Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

Mandatory:

8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.
Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).
Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.
Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.
Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.
Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.
Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.
Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.
Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.
A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.
You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to

Key Responsibilities:

A. Product Strategy & Development
Develop and manage retail finance products such as New Car Loans, Used Car Loans, refinancing, top-up loans, buyback programs, balloon schemes, assured resale value programs, and other tailored financing structures.
Conduct market research, competitor benchmarking, and customer insights to identify product opportunities.
Conceptualize and launch new product offerings aligned with OEM retail strategy and customer buying behaviour.
Design customer-centric value-added offerings (insurance, extended warranty finance, service package finance, accessories finance, loyalty programs).

Build product approval notes, business cases, and policy documentation.
Track product profitability, yield, and portfolio performance; recommend revisions to maintain competitiveness.
Manage OEM subvention schemes and retail program rollouts across dealership networks.

Conduct product training sessions for dealer finance teams, DSA’s and internal sales teams.
Monitor national/regional product performance and implement corrective action plans.
Optimize dealer-level product adoption and ensure availability of proper product communication materials.
D. Digital Journey & Process Enhancement
Work with technology and digital teams to build seamless retail loan journeys, including lead management, credit decisioning automation, KYC/Video KYC, e-agreement, e-mandate, and onboarding workflows.
Enhance customer experience by simplifying loan documentation, disbursal process, and turnaround time (TAT).
Identify and digitize manual steps to increase productivity and reduce operational costs.

Headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, Deutsche Börse Group is a leading international exchange organization and market infrastructure provider. They empower investors, financial institutions, and companies by facilitating access to global capital markets.

Deutsche Börse Group in India is composed of a team of capital market engineers forming the backbone of financial markets worldwide.

Field of activity:

This is a multi-year program professionalizing and standardizing the handling of CMDB, Asset Management, ITSM and other processes/activities. The IT SAM Program is pursuing a.o. following goals:
Deliver a group wide IT-Service & Asset Management Platform in the cloud in line with the enterprise architecture
Replace legacy technology (CRM7) to Cloud native technology track
Drive cultural change form proprietary DBG specific implementation into a SaaS solution

Your Mission:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Product Owner to lead the topic of Integration and Reporting by means of API’s and Dashboards in our IT-Service & Asset Management (IT SAM) capabilities. You will be at the heart of our digital transformation, driving the implementation and evolution of our new central platform. This is a key role in shifting our culture from a legacy, process-heavy environment to a modern, cloud-native, and service-oriented model.
If you are a practical leader who thinks in terms of products and services that deliver real value, and you are passionate about building modern IT solutions, this is the role for you. We need a doer, not just a theorist, who can cut through complexity and guide our organization towards a more efficient and user-centric future.

Tasks / Responsibilities:
Own the Product Vision & Strategy: You will define and champion a clear product vision for IT Service and Asset Management. You'll translate the strategic goals of our multi-year transformation program into a prioritized, value-driven product backlog. This includes owning, developing, maintaining, prioritizing and securing completeness of the Product Backlog with, on top of business requirements, external and internal audit items, BAU activities and Enablers.
Lead with a Practical Mindset: While familiarity with ITIL is essential, your focus will be on practical application. You will pragmatically balance business needs with governance requirements, ensuring we build effective services, not just "paper tiger" processes.
Drive Agile Execution: As the "Voice of the Customer," you will guide our Agile development team. This includes breaking down features into clear user stories, defining objectives, goals and acceptance criteria, and ensuring the team is always working on what matters most. You will be the final authority on accepting work, using Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) practices and practices like Definition of Ready (DoR) and the Definition of Done (DoD), ensuring the final product meets our high standards.
Champion Service Adoption & Value: You will own the strategy for product adoption, ensuring users understand and benefit from the new platform. A key part of your role will be evaluating new features from our SaaS vendor to ensure we are maximizing the value of our investment.
Collaborate and Communicate: You will be the central point of contact between senior stakeholders, business users, and the development team. Your ability to communicate clearly and manage relationships at all levels will be critical to aligning everyone on the product roadmap and ensuring smooth execution.
Manage the Basics: This includes managing JIRA / Confluence / Sharepoint together with the Product Team. Organizing, preparing and following up different types of program meetings. Contributing to program communication content and channels (mail, newsletter, intranet)

Qualifications / Required skills:

Deep Domain Expertise: Strong, hands-on experience with Integration, Reporting by means of API’s and Dashboards on IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and a deep understanding of the underlying data (CMDB).
Practical SaaS Implementation Skills: Demonstrated experience in implementing and managing enterprise SaaS solutions (ServiceNow experience is a significant advantage). You understand how to leverage out-of-the-box capabilities over excessive customization.
A Product & Service Mentality: You are a strategic thinker who focuses on customer needs and delivering tangible business value. You have a track record of simplifying complex problems and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Leadership & Influence: Excellent communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills. You are confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and can operate effectively in a multi-national environment.
Industry Context: Experience working in the financial services industry or another highly regulated environment is highly desirable.
Language: Excellent proficiency in written and spoken English is required. Basic German is a plus.

About ELSA

ELSA is a global leader in AI-powered English communication training, dedicated to transforming how people learn and speak English with confidence. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, we operate across the U.S., Vietnam, Portugal, Indonesia, Brazil and Japan.

Powered by proprietary speech-recognition technology and generative AI, ELSA delivers real-time, hyper-personalized feedback to help learners improve pronunciation, fluency, and overall communication effectiveness. With over 50 million learners and 1 billion hours of anonymized speech data, ELSA's depth of language training intelligence is unmatched in the industry.

Our consumer products help millions of learners build practical English communication skills through personalized, bite-sized learning experiences. ELSA combines AI-powered coaching, speech recognition, adaptive learning, and engaging product experiences to help users build consistent learning habits and make measurable progress.

Our vision is to become the global standard for real-time English communication training, enabling 1.5 billion language learners worldwide to speak clearly, be understood, and share their stories with the world.

Backed by world-class investors including Google's Gradient Ventures, Monk's Hill Ventures, and SOSV, ELSA has been recognized among the top global AI innovators:

Forbes Top 4 Companies Using AI to Transform the World
Research Sniper Top 5 Best AI Apps
ASU+GSV EdTech 150
CB Insights Top 100 AI Companies

We are scaling aggressively on the consumer side — moving from a language-learning app into a highly personalized AI communication coach that users build into their daily lives. That means stronger engagement loops, smarter personalization, better learning outcomes, and a product experience that drives long-term retention and subscription growth.

Join us in shaping the future of language learning and empowering millions to unlock opportunity through confident communication.

Job Overview

As Product Manager for B2C, you will own the product experience for ELSA's consumer learners — from the moment a user discovers and starts using ELSA to the point where they build a lasting learning habit, subscribe, improve their English, and continue their journey with the product.

You'll work closely with the Product, Engineering, AI/ML, Design, Marketing, and Data teams to build experiences that drive acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, learning outcomes, and subscription revenue.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll own key parts of the consumer product journey and use a combination of user research, behavioral data, experimentation, and business metrics to identify opportunities and prioritize what to build next.

You'll sit close to both user growth and revenue — your roadmap will directly influence user engagement, retention, conversion, and LTV.

Build product experiences that turn new users into activated learners and help them quickly understand ELSA's value
Design and optimize engagement loops and learning habits that keep users coming back consistently beyond their first few weeks

Establish and monitor product success metrics, ensuring new features deliver measurable improvements in user behavior, learning outcomes, and business performance

Communicate product strategy, priorities, trade-offs, and results clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

Must-Haves

Strongly Preferred

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status”.

Business insight 

At Société Générale, we are convinced that people are drivers of change, and that the world of tomorrow will be shaped by all their initiatives, from the smallest to the most ambitious. Whether you’re joining us for a period of months, years or your entire career, together we can have a positive impact on the future. Creating, daring, innovating, and taking action are part of our DNA. If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!

Still hesitating?

You should know that our employees can dedicate several days per year to solidarity actions during their working hours, including sponsoring people struggling with their orientation or professional integration, participating in the financial education of young apprentices, and sharing their skills with charities. There are many ways to get involved.

We are committed to support accelerating our Group’s ESG strategy by implementing ESG principles in all our activities and policies. They are translated in our business activity (ESG assessment, reporting, project management or IT activities), our work environment and in our responsible practices for environment protection.

About Target

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

About Team & Role

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will shape the strategic vision and own the roadmap for a complex product domain. You will partner with Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams to establish short- and long-term goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Principal Product Manager based in India is a strategic senior individual contributor who serves as a force multiplier across product strategy, platform evolution, and AI transformation within Target’s Service Centre product ecosystem. This role provides strategic product leadership across business and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. The Principal Product Manager will shape the long-term evolution of Digital Servicing, AI-enabled experiences, operational platforms, and enterprise insight capabilities serving Guests, team members, partners, and business functions. The role partners closely with the Director of Product Management to transform core servicing capabilities and accelerate the responsible adoption of AI, automation, and intelligent experiences.

Detailed Job Description

Success in this role is demonstrated through the ability to shape the long-term evolution of Digital Servicing, elevate product management maturity, influence enterprise priorities without direct authority, and deliver measurable improvements in Guest experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. The Principal Product Manager is a strategic thought leader, trusted partner, mentor, and force multiplier who accelerates product excellence across the TES portfolio.

Strategic Product Leadership

Influence product investment decisions to align with TES and enterprise priorities.
Translate complex business challenges into scalable product opportunities with measurable outcomes.

Business and Product Outcomes

Ensure product investments generate measurable business value rather than technology outputs alone.

Product Maturity and Capability Building

Establish consistent product discipline and effective product-management practices across TES teams.

Enterprise Influence

Strengthen alignment between business strategy and product execution.
Reduce decision-making friction and accelerate execution across organisational and functional boundaries

About You

Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
10+ years of product management or equivalent domain experience, preferably within retail, consumer servicing, enterprise platforms, or AI-enabled products.
Demonstrated experience defining strategy and roadmaps for complex, enterprise-scale products or platforms.

Experience leading product-driven transformation across Technology, Data, Design, Operations, and business teams.

Expertise in agile product-development practices.

As Associate Product Owner you will start by working closely with a Senior Product Owner, contributing across discovery, delivery and adoption before progressively taking full ownership of a planning module as your domain and platform expertise deepens.

Once you own a module, you will drive it end-to-end from identifying capability gaps through design, build, UAT and go-live, to sustained adoption. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and business planning teams to deliver measurable improvement in planning capability and commercial outcomes.

You will be accountable for metrics that matter to your users, not a task list. You will be expected to have a point of view on what best-in-class looks like for your module and to argue for it.

Key Responsibilities
You will be expected to take end-to-end ownership of one planning module. This includes: 
Drive discovery and design with business
Run discovery with planners, buyers and planning centre of excellence to translate planning into clear product requirements.
Write crisp PRDs, process flows and acceptance criteria that engineering can build from without a second round of interpretation.
Work with solution architects and engineering on solution fitment; make explicit build-vs-configure-vs-defer calls and phase them sensibly.
Drive delivery with engineering
Run the squad's backlog with the engineering leads — groom, refine, unblock, and protect the sprint from scope drift.
Work with data engineering on the pipelines, integrations and data models your module depends on.
Own UAT planning and execution with business users; drive defect triage, cutover, training material and go-live readiness.
Partner with QA on test coverage for planning calculations — where a wrong number is a commercial decision gone wrong, not a cosmetic bug.
Drive adoption and outcomes
Track and move your module's metrics
Run post-go-live adoption: spend time with planners, find where the workflows are inadequateand close those gaps.
Report module performance and business impact to leadership on a regular cadence.
Build intelligence in, not on
Work with data scientists to identify and specify intelligence use cases for your module.
Define how recommendations surface inside the planner's workflow, what the planner can override, and how model output is validated.
Use AI natively in your own work. We expect you to be materially faster because of it.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Experience
3–6 years of experience in Product Owner / Associate Product Owner / Business Analyst / Consultant roles, with at least 2 years in a product ownership capacity.
Planning domain or planning product experience is essential — one or more of: 
Worked in a retail planning, merchandising, buying or supply planning team 
or
Worked on an enterprise retail planning product or implementation — Board, Anaplan, o9, Blue Yonder, Oracle Retail, SAP IBP or equivalent.
AI-native. Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI across the product lifecycle — not curiosity, but working practice. Bonus if you have shipped a product feature where an ML/AI model drove the user-facing decision.
Experience owning a product or module end-to-end through a full delivery cycle, including a go-live.
Comfortable working directly with engineering teams, solution architects and data engineers; able to hold a credible conversation about data models, integrations and calculation logic.
Experience working with cross-functional teams across geographies and time zones.
Experience in enterprise or platform products (as opposed to consumer apps) is preferred.
Retail or e-commerce background strongly preferred.
MBA preferred, not mandatory. A strong domain and delivery track record counts for more.

Skills & Attributes
Structured thinker; can take an ambiguous business complaint and turn it into a prioritised, sequenced roadmap.
Analytical; you should be comfortable interrogating planning data, variance, forecast accuracy and stock cover yourself rather than waiting for an analyst.
Outstanding written and verbal communication; can write a document that a head of planning and a backend engineer both find useful.
Strong stakeholder management; you will be saying "not this quarter" to senior people, and keeping them on side while you do it.
Bias to action and high ownership; Things you ship go live and get used the same week.
Excellent organisational and time management skills; able to run multiple parallel workstreams to deadline.
Attention to detail;precision and accuracy are your strong suit.

Job requirements

We are seeking an experienced AI Product Owner to lead the development, adoption, and scaling of ADAM — Brillio’s Agentic AI Platform within the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) domain. This role will drive how ADAM enables enterprises to transition from traditional digital transformation toward AI-led operating models, embedding intelligent agents, automation, and decision intelligence across core financial workflows. The AI Product Owner will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, domain experts, and ADAM engineering teams, ensuring that platform capabilities translate into measurable client outcomes. Key ResponsibilitiesADAM Product Strategy & Vision

Define BFSI industry vision and roadmap for ADAM adoption across banking and insurance clients. 
Identify high-impact agentic AI opportunities across underwriting, lending, fraud, risk, customer servicing, operations, and compliance. 
Translate business problems into reusable ADAM platform capabilities and agents backlog
Drive industry-specific productization aligned to Brillio’s platform strategy. 

ADAM Platform Ownership

Own end-to-end lifecycle of ADAM use cases — from ideation to enterprise deployment with the engineering teams. 
Define product backlog, user journeys, agent workflows, and acceptance criteria. 
Prioritize features balancing business impact, scalability, and regulatory constraints. 
Work closely with AI architects, data scientists, and engineering teams to operationalize ADAM capabilities. 

BFSI Domain Leadership

Bring deep understanding of banking or insurance operating models. 
Ensure ADAM solutions align with risk, compliance, and governance standards. 
Embed explainability, auditability, and responsible AI principles into agent workflows. 
Drive industry differentiation through domain-informed AI solutions. 

Client Engagement & Adoption

Act as product evangelist for ADAM within BFSI accounts. 
Partner with sales and consulting teams to shape AI transformation opportunities. 
Drive stakeholder alignment, user adoption, and value realization. 
Present roadmap, demos, and outcomes to senior client leadership. 

Required Qualifications

5-7 years of experience in Product Management, Consulting, or Technology Delivery. 
Strong experience in BFSI domain (Banking / Insurance / Financial Services). 
Experience delivering AI, Data, or Digital Platforms at enterprise scale. 
Experience operating in Agile product environments. 
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, GCP Vertex AI). 
Exposure to Responsible AI, regulatory frameworks, or model governance. 
Background in enterprise transformation or platform-led delivery. 
MBA or advanced degree in Technology, Data Science, or Business. 

Sharing a few additional criteria alongside the JD to support more effective shortlisting of candidates. looK for profiles with a strong mix of product strategy, domain understanding (good to have), solutioning, and consulting mindset, beyond core delivery responsibilities. Key considerations:

Experience in solving business problems, preferably within the BFSI domain
Strong understanding of the consulting and product strategy aspects, including problem framing based on market/industry insights, evaluation of solution approaches, and impact assessment prior to build
Ability to bridge leadership and engineering teams, translating product strategy into clear, actionable execution
Awareness of market trends and industry developments, with the ability to analyze these signals to inform product strategy, identify opportunity areas, and shape potential solution directions

Job Requirements

Key Responsibilities: 

Contextual Business Translation: Translating high-level industry problems and domain-specific business needs into concrete data science, prompt engineering, and LLM-centric requirements.
AI Value Maximization & Backlog Engineering: Prioritizing product backlogs based on algorithmic complexity, data availability, and business impact to maximize the ROI of AI features.
AI Requirements & Synthetic Stories: Discovering and managing requirements specifically tailored for machine learning and cognitive computing systems. Authoring synthetic user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases for systems where the output is probabilistic rather than deterministic.
Process Re-imagining & Agentic Workflows: Re-engineering current-state process flows to embed agentic workflows and automated decisioning. Mapping out human-in-the-loop feedback mechanisms for continuous model optimization cycles.
Governance & Probabilistic SLAs: Defining product success and performance guardrails for non-deterministic AI outcomes, such as accuracy thresholds, latency, and hallucination rates. Translating organizational ESG, compliance, and responsible AI guardrails into specific system requirements.

Primary Skills

Generative AI & LLM Familiarity: Deep understanding of the capabilities, constraints, and architecture of large language models and cognitive technologies, including commercial and open-source options, tokenomics, and cost optimization levers.
Agentic System Architecture Strategy: Understanding of how autonomous agents operate, with the ability to architect strategies around when to deploy point solutions versus autonomous, multi-agent automated systems.
Prompt Engineering & Model Steering: Ability to evaluate and refine system prompts, guardrails, and context windows to ensure alignment with product brand guidelines and craft advanced semantic structures for data synthesis.

Work Experience

10-15Years

Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Owner to drive the vision, roadmap, and delivery of key digital products, including FinOps and AI agent solutions. This role will own products end-to-end, ensuring they deliver measurable business value, drive adoption, and support WSA's digital transformation journey.

What You Will Own

FinOps. Our FinOps products give engineering teams and finance a shared, trustworthy view of cloud spend across our providers and push cost accountability into the teams that create the cost. You own their vision, roadmap and backlog end to end.
Discovery for what comes next. New products are taking shape in our cloud and platform strategy area. You will help develop them through product discovery, prototypes and stakeholder interviews, and give them a definition and a first roadmap. Who owns them in the end is decided later.
Possibly more. Depending on the profile we find, smaller existing products can be added to your responsibilities – our Backstage developer portal, or our Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud offerings, for example.
Outcomes, not output. You are measured on adoption across the applications on the platform and on the decisions that change because of your product, not on the number of stories closed. You present your roadmap and your results to leadership yourself.

What you will do

Talk to the people who use our FinOps products – platform teams, application teams and finance – and turn what you learn into a roadmap they recognise as theirs.
Write the user stories and acceptance criteria yourself. You know the difference between a story and a specification.
Prioritise against business value, technical feasibility and the platform strategy, and defend the ranking when it is challenged.
Work with the engineering team day to day: refinement, design reviews, demos and releases. You can read the code and the architecture, and you will.
Track adoption and outcomes, and act on what the numbers tell you.
Manage expectations and dependencies with stakeholders across WSA.
Run product discovery and stakeholder interviews for new products in the strategy area

What You Bring

A technical background: 5+ years in software engineering, architecture or platform engineering, and real responsibility for deciding what gets built – as a product owner, a tech lead or an architect.
You have shipped something other teams depend on – an internal platform, a service, a tool – and lived with the consequences.
You understand cloud platforms well enough to challenge an engineer's estimate and to spot when a cost report is wrong. Hands-on FinOps experience is a plus; the practice can be learned, the instinct cannot.
You have made a case to senior stakeholders, won some and lost some, and can explain what you would do differently.
You can work with an empowered agile team without needing to run it. Scrum or SAFe familiarity is useful; process for its own sake is not.
You are interested in LLM- and agent-based solutions and have a realistic view of what they can and cannot do today.
Clear written and spoken English, and comfortable working in a multi-region team across time zones..

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

You will sit between the engineering teams building our digital platforms and the project directors, client organisations and site teams who use them. Your job is to turn how infrastructure delivery actually works into specifications an engineering team can build against, and to keep what gets built honest to what was asked for.

What you'll own
Requirement gathering across a difficult stakeholder set. Project directors, resident engineers, client organisations and site teams each describe the same process differently. You will run the discovery, resolve the contradictions, and write the version everyone signs off on.
Specifications and acceptance criteria. Written clearly enough that an engineer can build from them and a reviewer can test against them.
Code and delivery review. Not as the approving engineer, but as the person who checks that what shipped matches what was specified, and who catches the edge cases nobody raised in the requirements session.
Feasibility judgement on AI features. Deciding what is genuinely deliverable, what is a demo dressed as a product, and how to phase the difference.
Translation in both directions. Explaining engineering constraints to non-technical stakeholders, and site realities to engineers who have never been to a project site.

What we're looking for
Requirements and elicitation experience. Evidence of specs you have written, acceptance criteria you have defined, and scope you have held. We are more interested in ambiguity you resolved than in features you listed.
A technical foundation strong enough to read code. A computer science degree, or several years shipping software before moving into product or analysis. You will not write production code, but you will read pull requests and judge whether an implementation matches its spec.
Written and spoken communication of a high standard. You will produce documents that go to senior stakeholders and to client organisations. Send us something you have written.
Working literacy in AI and agentic systems. Enough to challenge an estimate, evaluate a vendor claim, and understand why a demo that works on ten documents may not work on ten thousand.
Comfort with complex, regulated delivery environments. Structured processes, audit requirements and documentation standards should feel normal rather than obstructive.

Signals that would move you to the top of the list
Infrastructure, construction, EPC or PMC domain exposure — highways, bridges, railways, urban development, power, or water.
Experience with government or multilateral clients, and with the documentation and approval cycles they require.
Having worked on project monitoring, ERP, GIS or field-data-collection platforms.
Any hands-on work with LLM tooling, workflow automation, or data pipelines, however small.
Familiarity with BIM, DPR workflows, or construction supervision processes.

What this role is not
It is not a delivery or scrum-master role, and it is not roadmap authorship at a distance from the build. You will be in the detail: in requirement sessions, in the spec, in the pull request, and on site when that is what it takes to understand the problem.
Equally, it is not an engineering role. If you want to stay hands-on writing code, this will frustrate you.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil, and Goldman Sachs, and was named one of America’s best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Role

Tax is where trust is won or lost. Every calculation, filing, and payment is a promise to our customers and to the agencies they answer to. As Rippling scales into the enterprise and expands globally, the Tax Platform is mission-critical infrastructure: it must be accurate, explainable, and reliable at a level most payroll systems were never designed for.

We’re looking for a Director of Product, based in Bangalore, to lead Rippling’s Global Tax Platform team. You’ll own the end-to-end system that calculates, files, and pays taxes globally — across employees and contractors, across every country we operate in, and across federal, state, and local jurisdictions.

The scope covers:

Calculation engine, including the multi-year effort to build Tax Foundry — an AI-enabled tax calculation and policy engine that replaces our third-party dependency. 
Filings and agency communications across all jurisdictions globally. 
Tax payments and reconciliation — accurate, on-time, and fully traceable. 
Upstream data audits and self-serve resolution so issues are caught before they block filings. 
In-product explainability so every tax value can be traced to its source inputs and rules. 
Enterprise readiness — multi-entity, multi-country, equity comp, and complex tax structures at scale. 

The goal is simple: no surprises. Customers should never be caught off guard by their tax data, and the team should never be pulled into reactive firefights during filing season.

What You Will Do

Own the vision and execution for the Tax Platform across calculation, filing, payments, and reconciliation globally. 
Lead a team of Senior Product Leads across calculation, filings, payments, data quality, and enterprise tax. 
Drive measurable improvements in filing accuracy, on-time payment rates, weekly data accuracy, customer self-serve, and enterprise escalations. 
Make the call on Tax Foundry while maintaining a credible third-party backup plan. 
Build opinionated, configurable workflows that reduce reliance on Tax Ops and CX. 
Partner with Engineering, Tax Ops, CX, Payroll, Compliance, Legal, and GTM to align expansion with platform architecture. 
Serve as a Senior Product Leader in Bangalore, operating tightly with leadership in San Francisco. 

What You Will Need

Serve as a senior product leader in Bangalore, operating tightly with leadership in San Francisco. 
12+ years of Product Management experience. 
Proven experience leading senior IC PMs across multiple teams. 
Experience owning complex, multi-surface platforms with regulatory, tax, or financial complexity. 
Strong systems thinker — you see primitives, not just features. 
Track record of shipping both 0-to-1 launches and scaled products used by large customer bases. 
Comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: strategy, architecture, UX, and execution rigor. 
Strong cross-functional leadership across engineering, tax/compliance, operations, and GTM. 
High ownership mindset — accountable for outcomes, not output. 
Exceptional written and verbal communication in a highly cross-functional, globally distributed role. 
Payroll, tax, accounting, or fintech experience is a strong plus. 
Strong alignment with our leadership principles: in particular, Go and See, and Are Right, a Lot. 

If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be used in lots of different ways, your life experience is equally important sometimes.

About the Role


The Product Manager - NxtWave Academy owns the learning product: the experience that takes a student from enrolment through active learning to course completion. This is the product-side owner of the Academy's retention and engagement north star - the person who moves activation, weekly-active-learning, progression and in-journey drop-off through the product itself (features, nudges, personalization, AI-first learning tools). It is a hands-on, experimentation-first, AI-first role: you frame problems, separate assumption from evidence, and ship and read experiments rather than execute a pre-decided feature list.

What You'll Own


Learning Product & Funnel Ownership

  • Own and improve the in-product learner journey: activation -> active learning -> progression -> completion.
  • Define and track the Academy learning-product metric tree (activation, WAL, progression velocity, feature adoption, in-journey drop-off).
  • Diagnose drop-off with data before proposing a fix; instrument events and build the dashboards you rely on.

AI-First Product Delivery

  • Ship features leveraging LLMs, agents, retrieval and automation (adaptive practice, doubt-solving, recommendations); write clear PRDs/DRDs.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design and Data for fast, high-quality delivery; maintain backlog clarity across initiatives.

Experimentation & Prioritization

  • Run structured, hypothesis-driven experiments across the learning journey; read them honestly and kill bad bets.
  • Separate validated evidence from stakeholder assumption before committing engineering effort.
  • Prioritize a constrained roadmap and defend trade-offs.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Align Engineering, Design, Data, Curriculum and the Retention Head on a single prioritized roadmap.
  • Present recommendations - including 'no build' recommendations - to leadership with evidence.
  • Ensure learner privacy, data safety and ethical AI usage; own pre-launch QA and safe rollout.

What Success Looks Like

  • Improve new-learner activation rate (student reaches the first meaningful learning milestone) by an agreed % QoQ, owned end-to-end (hypothesis -> build -> measure -> iterate).
  • Reduce in-product drop-off at the weakest identified journey stage by an agreed % within 2 quarters of it being flagged.
  • Improve weekly-active-learner (WAL) rate and average course-progression velocity through product interventions (in-app nudges, streaks, resume-flows, personalization).
  • Ship statistically-sound product experiments every quarter across the learning journey, each with a documented hypothesis, result, and ship/kill/iterate decision.
  • Define, instrument, and own the Academy learning-product metric tree; every shipped initiative has a pre-defined success metric before engineering effort is committed.
  • Ship AI-first learning features (adaptive practice, doubt-solving, recommendations) that show measurable lift in progression or engagement for the targeted cohort.

Must-Have

  • Can walk through a real experiment: hypothesis, design, result, and the ship/kill/iterate decision it drove.

Good-to-Have

Senior Product Manager

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.
You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.
You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.
What You'll Own
Working with people
Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment
Building the roadmap
Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where they're heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform
Building the feature
Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems
Shipping the feature
Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
Work out why a launch is or isn't working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties
What We're Looking For
5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: you've built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
B2B SaaS experience is a must
Startup experience is required. You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch
How You Operate
High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
You surface risks early
Accountable: you own the wins and the misses
What Success Looks Like
Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move
Why You Want To Work Here
Competitive compensation
ESOPs
Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
Flexible leave program
Home workstation setup allowance
A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

It diagnoses the underlying drivers of weight gain, such as insulin resistance, inflammation and hormonal imbalances, and delivers personalised treatment under medical supervision through a fully online, subscription-based model. Every member is paired with a physician trained in obesity medicine and a dedicated health coach, supported by blood diagnostics and continuous glucose monitoring.

The company has onboarded over 30,000 paying members and is backed by Physis Capital, W Health Ventures, Narayana Health and other early-stage investors.

Role Summary

Doctors are at the centre of the Elevate Now model. The quality of every consult, prescription and follow-up depends on how well the tools around them work. As Product Manager for Doctor Experience, you will own the products that physicians use every day, making it faster and easier for them to review a member’s data, make sound clinical decisions and stay in sync with the health coach and care team.

Success looks like more consults handled per doctor without a drop in quality, less time spent on admin and documentation, higher doctor satisfaction and retention, and better member outcomes and adherence as a result.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Own the roadmap for doctor-facing products, including the consult workflow, patient records and charts, prescriptions, follow-ups and care plans.
Spend regular time with physicians to observe how they work, understand their pain points, and turn what you learn into clear product requirements.
Bring member data such as blood diagnostics, CGM readings, symptoms and progress into a clean, usable view that supports faster clinical decisions.
Reduce friction and documentation time through smart defaults, templates, automation and, where appropriate, AI assistance.
Build tools that improve collaboration between doctors, health coaches and support teams, including handoffs, escalations and shared notes.
Work with the clinical leadership team to translate protocols and safety guardrails into product logic, such as prescription checks and flags for follow-up.
Define and track metrics such as consult duration, doctor utilisation, documentation time, follow-up completion rate and doctor NPS.
Partner with engineering, design and data teams to ship quickly, run experiments and iterate on feedback.
Write clear PRDs and prioritise based on clinical impact, doctor productivity and member outcomes.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

3+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
Hands-on experience building products for doctors or clinicians, for example telemedicine or consult platforms, EMR or clinic management tools, or clinical workflow products.
Experience gathering insight directly from doctors and clinical teams and turning it into shipped product.
Comfort with sensitive health data and an understanding of why privacy, consent and clinical safety shape product decisions.
Working comfort with data (SQL or analytics tools) to measure usage, efficiency and outcomes.
Clear written communication and strong stakeholder management, including with senior clinicians.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in healthtech, digital health or a subscription-based care model.
Exposure to chronic care, metabolic health, obesity medicine or endocrinology workflows.
Experience building with or evaluating AI tools in a clinical or documentation setting.
Familiarity with prescription workflows and the regulatory context for telemedicine in India.
Experience in an early-stage startup where scope is broad and processes are still being built.

Benefits

Why Join Elevate Now
Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

What You'll Do
A successful Director – Product Management will be the facilitator and planner for all aspects of multiple product lines and will drive the activities of the corresponding teams who will build, integrate or enhance any new or existing products in their respective portfolio aligned to the product roadmap using Agile methodology. They will lead a team including Product Owners. The Director – Product Management will also co-ordinate & initiate appropriate vertical / product strategy coupled with the right POD with QA, Scrum Master, Architects and Developers. They will maximize product adoption, reusability and repeatability & focus on revenue growth to enable new logo strategic client acquisitions, improved customer experience & teamwork. More specifically, the individual in this role will:

Responsibilities:

Maintain ownership of product planning, development, and lifecycle management, providing guidance and direction to cross-functional teams to execute against product milestones

Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to translate business requirements, breaking them down into epics, themes, and features and creating actionable user stories with acceptance criteria for the design team to conceptualize and the development team to implement

Validate specifications with internal and external stakeholders to ensure they are consistent with articulated business requirements and deliver the expected results

Document new features and communicate functionality to end users

Actively measure and analyze existing products for opportunities to innovate and improve

Integrate performance metrics, usability studies, research and market analysis into product requirements to enhance user satisfaction

Demonstrate a willingness to experiment, iterate, innovate, and fail quickly

Collaborate with sales, operations, customer success managers, solution experts, technical experts and partners across multiple functions and geographic locations to present and position current and future product offerings

Provide dedicated product leadership for the assigned business areas, ensuring local time zone coverage and alignment with local market needs

Understand and advocate for the unique requirements of the assigned markets, ensuring platforms and solutions are adapted appropriately

Serve as the primary product liaison for regional stakeholders, providing visibility and prioritization of initiatives

Support the growth of the assigned business regions

Share regional insights and learnings with global product teams to inform platform strategy and encourage cross-regional alignment

What You May Need to be Successful:

Bachelor’s Degree in a business or technology field, advanced business degree (MBA preferred).

Minimum 5+ years in a product role for a product that handles over $1M in revenue at an org over $5M in revenue

Practical Agile experience - not certifications but actual experience inside an organization in transition for at least 5 years

Strong Technical skills - can speak with and motivate the development team with ideas and thoughts

kAIgentic is building the intelligence layer for the world's most ambitious enterprises. Headquartered in Singapore with teams in India and Japan, our software platform helps large organizations evolve as fast as technology itself by turning the tacit know-how locked inside their people into safe, governed, AI-powered operations.

The hardest part of enterprise transformation is not strategy. It is execution. Institutional knowledge lives in people's heads, systems are fragmented, and risk tolerance is low. kAIgentic captures how work actually happens, designs better workflows, and runs them inside an intelligence layer that is observable, auditable, and engineered for the most regulated environments on earth. The outcome is an enterprise that continuously improves.

We are backed by SMBC Group as our founding partner and customer zero, and our platform is already being proven inside one of the most complex, regulated operating environments in the world. That means real problems, real data, and real production impact from Day 1.

You will own one significant part of our product estate end to end: strategy, requirements, delivery and adoption. You will also be kAIgentic’s experience lead across the platform. You will set the principles and patterns every product follows, and own the journeys that cross product boundaries.

Our users do hard, regulated work: confirming how a bank process really runs, redesigning it, and deciding what to automate. The job is not to make that work look simple. It is to remove the labour that shouldn’t be there, keep the expert judgment that should, and make human review mean something.

What You’ll Do

Define the UX vision that maximizes adoption and quantifiable value across the kAIgentic product suite.

Architect integrated experience roadmaps that reconcile enterprise governance, legacy workflows, and AI capabilities into seamless user journeys.

Influence senior leadership, customers, and engineering partners to align feature priorities with reduced cognitive load and heightened trust.

Represent kAIgentic in customer workshops and industry panels, extracting tacit knowledge that refines the product experience.

Define measurable adoption and impact metrics, linking user behavior to business outcomes and informing iterative improvement.

Architect the translation of market, regulatory, and workflow insights into clear product briefs and decision criteria.

Influence the adoption of AI-enhanced design and research tools within product teams, accelerating evidence-based iteration.

Own your product area

Set strategy, roadmap and requirements. Write the specs engineering builds from, and make the scope calls, including what to cut.

Run discovery with the people who do the work. These are experts in banking operations, risk and compliance, often in Japan, and often in situations where you cannot observe the work directly.

Define success measures that tie user behaviour to outcomes and quality, such as effort per confirmed process, rework and review quality, not adoption alone.

Lead experience across the platform

Set the experience principles and interaction patterns all products follow. These cover how the product shows confidence and uncertainty, when it asks a person for input, and how review and approval work. Hold the bar in design reviews.

Own the journeys that cross products, so that what a user confirms in one carries cleanly into the next.

Design human review that auditors and regulators would accept as meaningful, not a rubber stamp, and define how we measure that it is.

Design for mixed audiences in the same flow: experts who use the product once or twice, and analysts who work in it daily.

Prototype with AI tools quickly enough to test ideas with users in days, and raise the team’s practice to match.

What You’ll Bring

Proven expertise delivering UX-focused product strategy for large-enterprise AI solutions, with a track record of driving adoption and measurable value

Mastery of product discovery and delivery frameworks, including hypothesis-driven research, PRD authoring, and iterative validation.

Deep knowledge of enterprise workflow analysis, governance models, compliance constraints, and integration patterns.

Expertise in AI research fundamentals and the ability to translate model capabilities into user-centric features.

Strong capability in designing and evaluating user experiences that reduce cognitive load, clarify intent, and build trust.

Skilled at synthesizing market, regulatory, and customer insights into concise product briefs and strategic direction.

Exceptional judgment in balancing technical feasibility, security, and scalability with user value.

Clear, persuasive communication with senior stakeholders, engineering, and customers, both in writing and presentations.

A track record of owning both a product and its experience in enterprise software used for complex, high-stakes work.

Judgment to separate essential complexity from accidental complexity. You can show where you removed work and where you deliberately kept it.

Experience designing oversight of AI or automated decisions, including how model uncertainty and failure reach the user.

Strong skill at eliciting knowledge from domain experts. Experience in a regulated industry, with banking preferred.

Hands-on prototyping, including fluency with AI design and prototyping tools. AI-native velocity as a default mode of working

Clear writing: specs, decision briefs and principles that others can apply without you in the room.

Influence without authority across product managers, engineering and global stakeholders. Experience with Japanese enterprise clients is a plus.

Why join kAIgentic?

We are a global team of builders who thrive in ambiguity, care deeply about the customers we serve, and believe the intelligence layer is how enterprise work will be reshaped over the next decade. We are building the connective tissue that lets large companies operate with the speed of a startup and the trust of an institution.

We look for people who:

Combine technical excellence with genuine customer empathy.

Are entrepreneurial and energized by zero-to-one problems with no playbook.

Lead with ownership, integrity, and collaboration, not titles.

Want to help define a new category of enterprise AI, not just ship inside an existing one.

Working here means being surrounded by peers who challenge assumptions, celebrate progress, and build with both courage and care.

Life at kAIgentic

Intelligence layer at the core. You will be shaping the substrate that turns institutional knowledge into governed, production-grade operations. This is enterprise infrastructure with real consequences.

Innovation at enterprise scale. Startup velocity meets the depth, scale, and stakes of mission-critical, regulated environments. Both are non-negotiable.

Ownership from Day One. Your work directly shapes the product, the culture, and the outcomes our customers see.

Learning and growth. You will work alongside seasoned leaders from leading enterprises who have built and scaled global businesses.

A culture of trust. Psychological safety, transparent disagreement, and disciplined experimentation are how we operate, not slogans on a wall.

Global collaboration. Teams across Singapore, India, Japan, Europe, and the US, working as one.

A mission worth the effort. Building something the world has not seen before: anintelligence layer that helps enterprises continuously improve how they run.

What You Will Bring:

B.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field is required. MBA preferred.

7+ years of overall experience, including 5+ years in Product Management. Experience in Product Adoption, Product Analytics, telemetry, insights, or related data-driven products is highly desirable.

Strong experience in strategy, roadmap planning, stakeholder management, and product execution.

Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and business stakeholders.

Familiarity with telemetry, product usage analytics, AI-powered recommendations, customer health metrics, or business intelligence solutions is preferred.

Self-motivated with strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills.

About the Team

This role reports to the Director of Product Management, responsible for Product Adoption & Insights, NIVA (Nutanix Intelligent Virtual Agent), Customer Success, and Professional Services Strategy.

The team focuses on helping customers realize value faster through trusted adoption insights, AI-powered recommendations, customer success innovations, and strategic services offerings.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India, and follows a hybrid work model.

About the Company

Elevate Now is a doctor-led clinical weight loss platform in India. It diagnoses the underlying drivers of weight gain, such as insulin resistance, inflammation and hormonal imbalances, and delivers personalised treatment under medical supervision through a fully online, subscription-based model. Every member is paired with a physician trained in obesity medicine and a dedicated health coach, supported by blood diagnostics and continuous glucose monitoring.

The company has onboarded over 30,000 paying members and is backed by Physis Capital, W Health Ventures, Narayana Health and other early-stage investors.

Role Summary

A member’s journey depends on physical things reaching them on time and in the right condition: medicines, diagnostic kits and sample collection, and devices. As Product Manager for Logistics & Fulfillment, you will own the product layer behind all of it, from the moment an order is created to the moment it is delivered, collected or returned.

Success looks like faster and more reliable delivery, a lower cost per order, fewer fulfillment related support contacts, and ops teams who can run a growing order volume without adding headcount at the same rate.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Own the roadmap for the logistics and fulfillment product surface, including order management, dispatch, delivery partner integrations, tracking, and returns or reverse logistics.
Define, track and improve core metrics such as order to delivery turnaround time, on time delivery rate, first attempt delivery success, RTO and NDR rates, and cost per order.
Work closely with operations, pharmacy or warehouse teams and delivery partners to turn on-ground problems into clear product requirements and tooling.
Build and improve integrations and routing logic with courier partners and 3PLs, including serviceability checks, partner allocation, SLA tracking and fallback handling.
Design ops-facing tools such as exception queues, dashboards and automation that reduce manual follow-ups.
Improve the member-facing delivery experience: delivery status and notifications, rescheduling, address handling and issue reporting.
Partner with clinical and compliance stakeholders so that prescription-linked and handling-sensitive workflows are built into the fulfillment flow.
Write clear PRDs, prioritise ruthlessly, run experiments, and use data to decide what to build next.
Collaborate with engineering, design and data teams to ship quickly and iterate.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

3+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
Hands-on experience building logistics, delivery or fulfillment products, for example order management, last mile delivery, WMS or OMS tooling, courier or 3PL integrations, or shipment tracking.
Experience in e-commerce, quick commerce, e-pharmacy, marketplace or a similar operations-heavy consumer business.
Strong understanding of operational metrics and how product changes move them.
Comfortable working with ops and field teams and translating their problems into product solutions.
Working comfort with data (SQL or analytics tools) to analyse funnels, delays and costs.
Clear written communication and strong stakeholder management.

Benefits

Why Join Elevate Now
Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

We are seeking a hands-on, data-fluent Technical Product Owner – Product Analytics & Telemetry to serve as the single source of truth for our product performance, user adoption, and platform utilization.

In this role, you won't just manage a backlog, you will dig directly into complex datasets across Databricks, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, WalkMe, and Datadog to quantify the real-world impact of our Jira initiatives. Multi-Source Telemetry Extraction: Query, blend, and analyze data across diverse infrastructure layers—including Databricks Delta Lake, Snowflake, relational databases (PostgreSQL), in-app workflow telemetry (WalkMe), and operational logs (Datadog).
Lakehouse Dashboards & Visualization: Architect and maintain high-performance Databricks SQL dashboards and visualizations to track cohort adoption, funnel drop-offs, feature utilization, and user retention.
Initiative Quantification & ROI: Map downstream user telemetry directly back to Jira initiatives and epics. Measure feature rollout velocity against actual adoption metrics to validate product bets.

Databricks Expertise: Strong familiarity working natively within the Databricks ecosystem (Databricks SQL, Lakeview dashboards, Delta tables).
Product Acumen & Agile Delivery: Solid understanding of modern product management frameworks, Jira project/initiative hierarchies, and KPI definitions (DAU/MAU, activation rates, cohort retention).

Experience operating within cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and understanding Delta Lake architecture.
Experience defining user event tracking frameworks from scratch (e.g., event naming conventions, schema contracts).

That means insight that finds the customer rather than waiting to be asked for, including generated insight and anomaly detection across their spend. It means data products built for a customer's own systems and agents to consume, not only for a person to read. And it means owning the trust layer underneath all of it, so that the answers our AI produces are accurate enough to put in front of a procurement executive.

Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

Principal PM AI Governance - Runtime Governance

About OneTrust

OneTrust helps organizations operationalize trust through privacy, security, data governance, and responsible technology adoption. As AI governance becomes a board-level and regulatory priority, customers increasingly need structured ways to understand AI systems, assess risk, monitor behavior, and demonstrate compliance over time.

The Challenge

We are looking for a Principal PM to help shape the future of our AI Governance product with a specific focus on observability and enforcement across AI systems. This role is for a product manager who can connect strategy, execution, and technical depth to help us build the right platform capabilities for the next generation of governed AI.

You will help run squad activities and drive clarity across product, engineering, design, and go-to-market stakeholders to ensure we are building capabilities that are durable, differentiated, and ready for where AI governance is heading next. The ideal candidate brings a strong product mindset along with a background in cybersecurity, SIEM and AI/MLOps.

Your Mission

Own and drive product direction for core AI Governance capabilities related to observability, policy enforcement, controls, and signal-driven governance across AI systems.

Gain visibility into AI systems, models, agents, and their behaviors over time using SIEM solutions 
Collect and operationalize governance signals across development, deployment, and runtime environments 
Enforce policies to build responsible AI and secure-AI use cases 
Investigate risk, drift, policy violations, and operational issues with confidence 
Connect governance requirements to measurable controls, workflows, and evidence for compliance outcomes

The squad is operating with strong product clarity, execution discipline, and measurable outcomes 
Customers can observe meaningful AI system behavior and governance signals in a way that supports action, not just reporting 
Enforcement capabilities are practical, scalable, and aligned to real enterprise governance workflows 
The product roadmap anticipates where AI governance is going, not just where the market is today 
Cross-functional partners see this product area as strategically coherent, technically credible, and commercially important

Experienced in AI/MLOps ecosystems, with experience in building SIEM and SOAR solutions including model lifecycle considerations, evaluation signals, runtime monitoring, and production governance patterns

Extra Impressive

Experience building products that connect governance requirements to operational systems and evidence

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
