Job Purpose

The Senior Product Manager for Commercial Cards will be responsible for strategic development in form of the build from scratch in terms of product, customer journey, technology, management, and growth of DBS's Commercial Cards product portfolio within the dynamic Indian market. This role involves driving product innovation, enhancing customer experience, ensuring market competitiveness, and achieving business objectives while adhering to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the Indian commercial cards landscape, including emerging payment trends like UPI, strong analytical skills, and a proven track record in product lifecycle management within the Indian financial services industry.

Key Accountabilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap: Develop and execute a comprehensive product strategy and roadmap for Commercial Cards in India, aligning with the bank's overall business goals, market trends, and RBI's directives on card issuance and conduct of business.
Product Development & Enhancement: Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from conceptualization and business case creation to launch and post-launch performance monitoring for new and enhanced commercial card products, considering specific Indian market needs and regulatory requirements. This includes features like online, NFC, and international transaction controls as per RBI mandates.
Market Competitiveness & Customer Experience: Continuously monitor market trends, competitor offerings from other Indian private banks (e.g., ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Axis Bank), and customer feedback to ensure commercial card products remain competitive and deliver a superior customer experience, potentially integrating with indigenous payment systems like RuPay.
Revenue Growth & Profitability: Drive the revenue growth and profitability of the commercial cards portfolio through effective pricing strategies, usage initiatives, and targeted campaigns, while also navigating any RBI restrictions on incentives or specific card offerings.
Risk & Compliance Management: Ensure all commercial card products and processes adhere to internal policies, regulatory requirements set by the RBI, and industry best practices for risk management and compliance, including mandates on card activation and usage.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Conduct in-depth market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for product innovation and differentiation in the Indian commercial cards space, staying abreast of developments in digital payments and fintech landscape in India.
Define product requirements, features, and functionalities based on customer needs, market analysis, and business objectives, incorporating features like spend management, online access, and integration with treasury services relevant to Indian businesses.
Collaborate closely with various internal stakeholders including Sales, Technology & Operations, Credit, Legal & Compliance, Marketing, and Customer Service to ensure successful product delivery and management, specifically addressing Indian market nuances.

About the Role
Delhivery moves millions of shipments every day, and every one of them has to be priced, invoiced, and collected correctly. A shipment billed late, billed wrong, or not billed at all is revenue the network earned but never banked. A disputed invoice also strains our relationship with a shipper. This role exists to fix that.
As Product Manager for Billing, you will own the product strategy for Delhivery's contract-to-cash engine, from rate card setup and shipment pricing through invoicing, dispute resolution, and collections. You will build systems that price every shipment accurately, catch revenue leakage before it reaches an invoice, and give shippers bills they trust. What You Will Do

Go deep before you go wide. Conduct structured deep-dives across rate cards, contract terms, weight and dimension capture, surcharges, credit notes, and reconciliation to find where and why revenue leaks. Quantify the financial impact of every gap before proposing a fix.
Bridge business reality and product design. Spend time with finance, BD, key account managers, and shippers. Understand why invoices get disputed, why contracts are hard to configure, and where manual work creeps in. Bring that context back into product decisions.

Keep everything compliant with GST, e-invoicing, and audit requirements.
Drive execution without losing sight of the bigger picture. Work closely with engineering, QA, finance, and ops to ship scalable solutions on time. Facilitate trade-off conversations between technical feasibility, financial controls, and business urgency, and make the call.
Prioritize ruthlessly. Apply first-principles thinking to separate high-impact initiatives from noise. Keep the team focused on what moves revenue and cash.

What You Bring
2+ years of product management experience in billing, fintech, ERP, logistics, or a fast-paced internet company

Billing is not a back-office function. It is where the value the network creates turns into revenue. Let’s be real: waiting for a health crisis to start taking care of your body is officially out. Proactive, specialist-led care is the new flex.

Welcome to MetaGO, where we are totally flipping the script on metabolic health and obesity in India. Kyunki scene ye hai, we want to change when India treats these issues, not just how.

Built by the OGs Varun Sheth, Zaheer Adenwala, and Kunal Kapoor—the same trio that scaled Ketto into a massive firm—MetaGO is rooted in one unapologetic truth: nobody should have to fight their biology alone.

Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.

The Meds Pipeline: The zero-friction logistics network getting meds from a prescription pad straight to a member’s doorstep.

Strategy: You can lay out a product vision and a multi-year strategy that gets everyone hyped to build.

Let’s build something epic together.

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding & KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.

This is a senior role for someone who can operate in ambiguity, get deep into customer, regulatory, data, and technical details, and turn complex problems into shipped product outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own product strategy and roadmap for APAC onboarding, KYC and financial crime mitigation initiatives, from discovery through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
Build and scale digital identity verification and eKYC experiences across markets such as Japan, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and the Philippines.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk & Compliance to balance conversion, customer experience, operational cost, regulatory requirements and financial crime risk.
Lead complex localisation work, including integrating local identity providers, registry checks, and APAC-specific controls into Wise’s global platform.
Improve customer onboarding outcomes such as first product adoption, verification completion, time-to-verify, manual review rates, cost-to-serve, and quality of fincrime decisions.
Mitigating risk of financial crime by ensuring our in-product control environment accounts for country-specific financial crime risks.
Use data, customer insight, operational feedback, and regulatory context to prioritise what matters most.
Help generalise APAC’s strongest onboarding and KYC capabilities so they can be reused by other Wise product teams.
Staying close to the details: customer journeys, dashboards, service architecture, regulatory interpretations, edge cases, incidents, and operational workflows.

Qualifications

What we’re looking for

Significant product management experience, ideally in finance/fintech, identity, onboarding, KYC, risk, compliance, fraud, trust & safety, or another regulated domain.
8+ years in the workforce with ideally 5+ years in product management or product-management adjacent roles. 
For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3+ years in a senior product manager role
A strong track record shipping customer-facing products end-to-end, not just writing strategy.
Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade-offs based on evidence.
Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,
Nice to have

Experience with KYC/KYB: digital identity, national ID systems, government registry integrations, biometric or document verification, business onboarding, 
Experience in financial crime prevention: risk models (e.g. machine learning models), fraud/scam product prevention
Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Description

Join Amazon Pharmacy's Supply Chain team and shape the systems that determine how medications reach patients. You will define product strategy and drive performance for the buying and inventory planning systems at the core of the pharmacy supply chain: procurement systems that decide what to buy and when under expiry and regulatory constraints, inventory planning that sets optimal stock levels across the network, and placement algorithms that position inventory across fulfillment centers. These systems are informed by demand forecasts that predict prescription volume, but your focus is turning that signal into smart purchasing and inventory decisions.

Pharmacy supply chains are unlike retail: demand is primarily driven by prescriptions (not browsing), products expire, controlled substances require compliance layers, and regulations vary by state. Every buying and inventory decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.

We are looking for a dynamic, analytically rigorous Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how Amazon Pharmacy determines optimal inventory levels, decides what and when to buy, simulates network decisions, and identifies unhealthy inventory — with demand forecasting as a key input to those decisions. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across these domains — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying optimization and ML systems.

Translate complex supply chain and healthcare constraints (expiry, controlled substances, state regulations) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
Design and own the end-to-end metrics framework for pharmacy supply chain health within your domain
Work with Operations, Compliance, Vendor Management, Fulfillment, Finance, and In-Stock partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
Partner with Applied Scientists and ML Engineers to define success criteria for forecasting models, optimization algorithms, and automated decision systems
Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment

Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent

Role Overview

Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Roadmap
Define and manage the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for R2R capabilities across general ledger, journal entry management, account reconciliations, intercompany accounting, fixed assets, close orchestration, consolidation, and financial reporting.
Prioritize product investments based on client needs, market relevance, business value, implementation feasibility, and measurable Finance outcomes.
Own the product lifecycle from discovery and concept validation through build, release, adoption, performance optimization, and product enhancement.
Assess product-market fit and continuously refine capabilities using user feedback, implementation insights, process benchmarks, and product performance data.

R2R Process & Solution Design
Lead discovery workshops with controllers, chief accounting teams, shared services leaders, and R2R operations to identify pain points, exceptions, control gaps, and automation opportunities.
Translate business requirements into product requirements, process flows, functional designs, user journeys, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and non-functional requirements.
Design configurable solutions for journal preparation and approval, balance-sheet reconciliations, variance analysis, close task management, intercompany matching, and reporting workflows.
Ensure product designs address financial controls, segregation of duties, audit trails, data lineage, evidence retention, exception handling, and regulatory requirements.

AI, Analytics & Automation
Define AI and automation use cases for journal recommendation and validation, reconciliation matching, anomaly detection, variance commentary, account-risk identification, close-status prediction, and intelligent exception routing.
Partner with AI, data science, and engineering teams to convert R2R use cases into explainable, secure, and production-ready features.
Design agentic workflows that coordinate data collection, validation, exception investigation, approval, and reporting while maintaining appropriate human oversight and controls.
Define success measures for AI-enabled features, including accuracy, exception reduction, user adoption, cycle-time improvement, control effectiveness, and model performance.

Product Delivery & Agile Execution
Create and maintain product requirement documents, prioritized backlogs, release plans, and product documentation.
Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, product reviews, user acceptance readiness, and release sign-off with cross-functional Agile teams.
Coordinate engineering, QA, UX, data, security, compliance, and implementation workstreams to ensure timely and high-quality releases.
Manage product dependencies, risks, scope decisions, and trade-offs while maintaining alignment with customer requirements and strategic outcomes.

Present product capabilities, R2R transformation use cases, solution value, roadmap, and ROI narratives to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, effort estimation, product positioning, and first-engagement solutioning.
Create sales and implementation collateral, including demo scripts, solution one-pagers, process maps, product playbooks, and value-assessment tools.

Product Performance & Adoption
Define and track product and business metrics such as close-cycle duration, manual journal reduction, reconciliation auto-match rate, aged unreconciled items, exception resolution time, on-time close tasks, adoption, and user satisfaction.
Use product telemetry, operational data, implementation feedback, and stakeholder input to identify enhancement opportunities.
Drive change adoption by partnering with implementation, training, and operations teams on rollout plans, user guidance, and feedback loops.

Qualifications & Experience
9-12 years of total experience, with strong exposure to Finance transformation, digital products, or enterprise technology solutions.
At least 4-5 years of product management, product ownership, consulting, or solution-design experience, including ownership of roadmaps and delivery backlogs.
Strong functional knowledge of R2R processes, including general ledger, journals, account reconciliation, intercompany, fixed assets, month-end close, consolidation, and financial reporting.
Experience delivering products or transformation programs from ideation through design, build, testing, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Working knowledge of ERP and Finance platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, BlackLine, Trintech, OneStream, or similar solutions.
Experience with AI, machine learning, Generative AI, workflow automation, analytics, or intelligent document processing in Finance is strongly preferred.
Understanding of cloud platforms, APIs, data integration, master data, security, controls, and enterprise architecture concepts.
Experience working in Agile product teams; CSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or equivalent certification is preferred.

Skills & Competencies
Product strategy, roadmap management, market and user discovery, backlog prioritization, and lifecycle management.
Strong R2R domain expertise with the ability to connect process pain points to scalable digital product capabilities.
Ability to write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and executive-ready product narratives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an outcome-led approach to product decisions and prioritization.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across Finance, technology, operations, and leadership audiences.
Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, AI/data science, UX, QA, security, compliance, sales, and implementation teams.
Comfort with ambiguity, competing priorities, and fast-paced product environments.
Working proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Excel, Power BI, or Tableau is preferred.

Preferred Profile

Experience creating demos, thought leadership, client proposals, and business cases for R2R transformation products.
Ability to bridge functional Finance requirements with technology, AI, controls, and user-experience considerations.

Senior Product Manager, Search, Indexing and Query

Couchbase | Product Organisation | Bangalore, India | Reports to VP of AI Product Management

About The Role

Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. Search, indexing and query are the core of it — how data is found, filtered, ranked and returned is what determines whether an application, or an agent, can actually use the data underneath. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own that surface area across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise: the SQL++ query experience, secondary indexing, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch. Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, you will partner closely with the query, indexing and search engineering teams, with sales and GTM, and with the broader AI organization.

You do not need to have shipped a query engine or a search product before. We are hiring for the underlying capability, not the resume line — see “Who This Role Is Open To” below.

What You Will Own

Search, indexing and query as a product surface: End-to-end ownership of how customers express and satisfy a query on Couchbase — SQL++ query, global secondary indexes, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption, and the iteration after launch.

Retrieval for AI applications: Make Couchbase the retrieval layer that RAG applications and agents actually use — hybrid search relevance, metadata filtering, recall and freshness, and cost per query. Work with the wider AI portfolio so retrieval composes with the rest of the platform rather than sitting beside it.

Developer experience for query and indexing: How a developer writes a query, gets an index recommendation, debugs a slow plan, and understands what a query costs. Reduce the number of things a developer has to know before their first query is fast.

Performance, cost and benchmark credibility: Own the performance story for your area. Reproducible benchmarks the field can stand behind, a defensible cost and TCO narrative against MongoDB, Elastic, Postgres and pgvector, and dedicated vector stores, and a clear point of view on where Couchbase wins and where it does not.

Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.

Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the query, indexing and search engineering teams. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.

Customer and design partner engagement: Run design partner programs for the capabilities you own. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Help build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.

Cross-portfolio collaboration: Coordinate across Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team so the capabilities you own compose cleanly with the rest of the platform. Bring a build-vs-partner point of view to your area.

Sales and GTM partnership: Equip sales, sales engineering, PMM, and partner GTM with what they need to win on search, indexing and query — positioning, demos, competitive context, benchmark data, customer proof points. Be the product owner in deals where the technical depth matters.

External voice: Contribute as the product owner in customer briefings, webinars, blog posts, documentation, and enablement content for the capabilities you own. Support analyst engagements and keynote content led by the Principal PM, PMM, and AR.

AI-driven PM practice: Use AI deeply and visibly in your own product management work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, benchmark analysis, engineering collaboration. Adopt and contribute to the team’s AI-driven PM and AI-DLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) practices in day-to-day execution.

Raising the bar: Share what works. Contribute to PRFAQ and PRD standards, interview loops, and onboarding. Mentor associate and early-career PMs as the team grows.

What You Will Deliver

PRFAQs and PRDs for the capabilities you own, validated with named enterprise customers before engineering starts.

Shipped capabilities across query, indexing and search with measurable adoption and at least one named reference customer per major launch.

A published, reproducible performance and cost position for your area that sales and engineering both stand behind.

Clear, defensible tradeoff decisions visible to engineering, sales, and GTM. The team knows what is in, what is out, and why.

Sales and GTM enablement that the field actually uses — measured by pipeline influence and win-rate signals, not enablement-decks-produced.

Contributions to the broader platform narrative — customer-facing content, blog posts, and documentation in partnership with the AI Specialist team, PMM, and AR.

Visible AI-driven PM practice — concrete examples of AI-DLC in your daily work that the rest of the team can learn from.

Must Have

Seven or more years in product management, with at least three on a technical platform — database, data infrastructure, search, analytics, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure.

Systems depth. You can reason about latency, throughput, recall, index structures, query plans, memory and storage tradeoffs, and cost per operation. Given a benchmark or a slow query, you know what to ask next.

Customer obsession and working-backwards rigor: You start with the customer and work backwards. You write PRFAQs before code. You can tell which feature requests reflect universal ICP needs and which are noise, and you make the call clearly.

Engineering credibility: Engineers want to work with you. You hold your own on architecture, are decisive on scope, and own the why behind every tradeoff.

Cross-functional trust: Sales trusts your roadmap. GTM trusts your enablement. Marketing trusts your narrative. You build durable working relationships outside your own team.

AI-driven PM practice: You already use AI in your own PM work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis — and you can point to concrete examples.

Product Manager

Requirements

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

– Own the WFM Product Vision & Strategy:

Develop, articulate, and execute a compelling vision and strategic roadmap for the WFM product line, aligned to customer needs, market trends, and company goals.

– Drive Full Product Lifecycle:

Lead the end-to-end process from market discovery and concept validation through launch, adoption, and scaling. Measure success against business outcomes (growth, adoption, customer satisfaction, retention).


Be the Customer and Market Expert:


Deeply understand contact centre and workforce management domains. Identify emerging needs, market shifts, and technology trends to create differentiated offerings.


Product Creation & Innovation:


Identify new product opportunities, develop business cases, and lead ideation, design, and MVP/prototype delivery. Take a hands-on approach to both strategy and execution.


Strategic Stakeholder Engagement:


Act as the product ambassador with key customers (including enterprise and strategic accounts), executive sponsors, and partners. Gather high-level feedback and incorporate it into roadmap decisions.

– Go-to-Market Ownership

Work closely with commercial, customer success, and marketing teams to define go-to-market, pricing, and enablement.

Collaborate with engineering, UX, QA, support, and operations to deliver high-quality products on time and to specification. Champion a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

Lead discovery and validation with customers, advisory councils, and EAP/beta programs; write clear requirements and acceptance criteria, prioritize the backlog with engineering and UX, and make defensible trade-offs on scope, quality, and timing.

– Experience engaging directly with executive-level customers, strategic partners, and cross-functional teams.

– Strong technical understanding of SaaS, cloud ecosystems, and the software delivery lifecycle.

– Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to have:

– Experience with global product delivery in multi-site teams.

– Experience as a contact centre workforce planner or in a management role managing planning/forecasting teams.

– Exposure to AI/ML, automation, and analytics in workforce management.

– Experience in complex B2B software environments.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related) or equivalent practical experience.

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

Description

What if running an e-commerce business could become dramatically simpler — with AI helping sellers manage orders, inventory, pricing and operations across every channel they sell on?

Amazon Smart Commerce is looking for a Principal Product Manager - Tech to lead SmartHub (including the team of PMs), our multi-channel commerce operations platform. SmartHub brings together orders, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and business insights across marketplaces and D2C channels into a single system, helping businesses operate at scale without navigating multiple disconnected tools.

We are now at an exciting inflection point. Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows that tell sellers what happened, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf.

As the Principal PM for SmartHub, you will define this next chapter. You will own the long-term product vision and roadmap for SmartHub and lead important horizontal capabilities such as pricing that span the broader Smart Commerce portfolio.

This is a role for a product builder who enjoys solving complex platform problems, operating in ambiguity and translating emerging technology into simple products that deliver measurable customer and business impact.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for SmartHub, Amazon Smart Commerce's multi-channel operations platform spanning order management, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and analytics.

Define how AI and agentic experiences can transform commerce operations — helping businesses move from manually operating software toward systems that understand business context, surface opportunities and risks, recommend decisions and automate repetitive work.

Reimagine high-frequency seller workflows such as order processing, inventory management, exception handling, returns and pricing to make operating across multiple sales channels dramatically simpler.

Lead horizontal product capabilities such as pricing that can create leverage across SmartHub and the broader Smart Commerce portfolio.

Develop a deep understanding of sellers ranging from emerging businesses to high-volume brands, including the operators who use SmartHub every day in warehouses and back offices.

Use customer research, product data and business insights to identify the highest-value problems and translate them into simple, scalable product experiences.

Partner deeply with engineering, science and UX teams on complex platform and AI problems, making thoughtful trade-offs across customer experience, reliability, scalability and speed.

Define and drive metrics across adoption, engagement, operational efficiency, seller experience and business impact.

Work across Amazon and external commerce ecosystems to build integrations and capabilities that allow businesses to operate seamlessly across marketplaces and D2C channels.

Influence senior leaders and partner teams across organizational boundaries to establish long-term product and technology direction.

Raise the product management bar through strong product judgment, first-principles thinking, clear written narratives and mentorship of other product leaders.

A day in the life

You might start the day speaking with a seller or warehouse operator processing thousands of orders across Amazon, Flipkart and their own website, identifying where manual work and exceptions slow them down. Later, you could work with engineers and scientists on an AI agent that detects inventory risks or automates an operational workflow, review adoption and reliability metrics with the team, and then align senior leaders on a multi-year product strategy. You will move fluidly between warehouse-floor details, customer experience, platform architecture, AI possibilities and business strategy.

About The Team

Amazon Smart Commerce is building the technology infrastructure for agentic commerce that helps businesses sell and operate wherever their customers shop.

SmartHub is our multi-channel operations platform, helping sellers bring orders, inventory, catalog, returns and business insights from multiple marketplaces and D2C channels into one system. It is built for the operational realities of commerce — high-volume events, warehouse workflows, complex integrations and businesses that cannot afford downtime.

We believe AI creates an opportunity to reinvent this category. Our ambition is to evolve from software that helps sellers manage workflows to an intelligent commerce operating system that helps them run and grow their businesses.

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

Product Manager : Consumer Experience

We’re looking for a Product Manager who turns customer understanding into shipped outcomes.
MyYogaTeacher helps people across the world improve their health and well being through live, personalized yoga. We connect students with experienced yoga teachers in India for 1-on-1 sessions designed around their goals, lifestyle, health conditions, and preferences.
Our platform has served 200K+ customers and supports thousands of live sessions across time zones, devices, payment systems, and customer journeys.
We are now entering a phase where speed, clarity, and execution matter more than ever.
We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager who can speak with students, understand their real motivations, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and work closely with design, engineering, analytics, sales, and operations to ship meaningful improvements quickly.
This is not a role for someone who only writes requirements, manages Jira, or waits for complete data before making a decision.
You will be expected to understand the customer, form a point of view, bring teams together, and drive the product from problem discovery through execution and measurable impact.

What You’ll Own
Customer and Persona Understanding
Develop a deep understanding of our students—their goals, anxieties, motivations, objections, habits, and reasons for choosing personalized yoga.
Regularly speak with prospective students, active customers, churned customers, teachers, sales teams, and customer support teams.
Convert customer conversations, behavioral data, support tickets, sales calls, and session feedback into clear product insights.
Build and continuously refine customer personas and journey maps based on evidence rather than assumptions.
Understand the underlying job the customer is hiring MyYogaTeacher to do—not merely the feature they are requesting.
Ensure that product decisions remain connected to why MyYogaTeacher exists: helping people build healthier, happier, and more sustainable lives and identify ambivalence.

Product Discovery and Decision Making
Identify high impact opportunities across acquisition, trial, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention, referrals, and reactivation.
Clearly define the customer problem, target persona, expected behavior change, and desired business outcome before proposing a solution.
Form strong product hypotheses using qualitative insights, product analytics, market understanding, and business context.
Make thoughtful decisions even when information is incomplete or circumstances are changing.
Distinguish between decisions that require deeper research and decisions that can be made quickly and reversed later.
Maintain a clear product decision log so teams understand what was decided, why it was decided, and what assumptions are being tested.
Challenge weak assumptions, unnecessary complexity, and solutions that do not address the underlying customer problem.

Execution and Delivery
Take end to end ownership of product initiatives from problem discovery to launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
Translate product opportunities into clear requirements, user journeys, success metrics, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.
Work closely with design and engineering to reduce ambiguity and unblock decisions quickly.
Break large initiatives into smaller releases that allow the team to learn and deliver customer value sooner.
Participate actively throughout development instead of handing over requirements and waiting for completion.
Review product builds continuously, identify gaps early, and ensure that the final experience solves the intended problem.
Drive weekly execution across multiple product initiatives while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
Follow through after launch to measure adoption, identify friction, and improve the product based on actual customer behavior.

Product Analytics and Business Impact
Define measurable outcomes for every major product initiative.
Use funnel analysis, cohort analysis, customer segmentation, experiment results, and qualitative feedback to understand product performance.
Monitor key metrics across trial completion, trial-to-paid conversion, onboarding, session attendance, engagement, retention, referrals, and customer satisfaction.

About The Company

Why We Built Lyric: Supply chains are more critical and complex than ever. Every day, large enterprises navigate trillions of possible decisions that could impact the bottom line. Powerful algorithms and AI can address these problems, yet most organizations struggle to leverage supply chain AI at scale. The current SCM technologies are either rigid, limited-scope point solutions or custom solutions built in-house, which demand immense expertise and investment.

That is…until now.

Enter Lyric: Lyric is an enterprise AI platform built specifically for supply chains, offering the best of both worlds:

Out-of-the-box AI solutions for optimizing networks, allocating inventory, scheduling routes, planning fulfillment capacity, promising orders, propagating demand, building predictions, analyzing scenarios, and more, plus
A platform-first approach that empowers both business and technical users with end-to-end product composability, leveraging no-code tools, their own code, or even forking our code to build and refine supply chain decision intelligence

With Lyric, enterprises no longer have to choose between flexibility and speed, they get both.

The Mission: We’re building a new era in supply chain with the team best equipped to lead it. With over 20 years at the intersection of supply chain and algorithms, we developed a deep conviction that global supply chains needed something like Lyric. Since our inception in December 2021, that conviction has been validated time and time again.

Today, a growing number of Fortune 500 companies, including Smurfit WestRock, Estée Lauder, Coca-Cola, and more, are innovating on their own terms with Lyric. We can’t wait to see what our customers, both current and future, are empowered to build with us next. Come build with us!

The Role

Retail planning is still largely built around planners navigating workflows, interpreting data, making hundreds of decisions, and manually translating those decisions into action.

We think there is a fundamentally different future.

At Lyric, we're building the next generation of Retail Planning capabilities, combining deep planning intelligence with agent-first product experiences that can reason, recommend, act, and increasingly execute planning work autonomously.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Retail Planning to help build that future.

This isn't just about digitizing existing retail planning workflows. You'll help determine which decisions should remain planner-led, which should become AI-assisted, and which can become truly autonomous.

What You'll Do

Build Lyric's Retail Planning capabilities

Own product strategy and execution for major Retail Planning workflows across Hardlines and Softlines. 
Develop a deep understanding of how retailers make assortment, inventory, allocation, replenishment, pricing, and related planning decisions. 
Translate messy, interconnected planning problems into clear product primitives, workflows, and capabilities. 
Work directly with retailers and planners to understand where existing planning systems break down and where Lyric can create step-change improvements. 
Define product requirements, prioritize the roadmap, and drive products from discovery through launch and adoption. 

Reimagine Retail Planning for an agent-first world

Challenge the assumption that planning software should simply provide better dashboards and workflows. 
Identify planning decisions and activities that AI agents can analyze, recommend, orchestrate, or execute autonomously. 
Design human-agent interactions that give planners leverage without removing the context, judgment, and control they need. 
Work with AI/ML and engineering teams on products that reason across large amounts of retail data and operate across multi-step planning workflows. 
Help define what the role of the retail planner looks like when agents can increasingly perform the repetitive analytical and operational work. 

Become deeply embedded in the customer problem

Spend significant time with planning teams, operators, and retail leaders. 
Develop strong intuition around differences between categories, channels, seasons, inventory structures, and retail operating models. 
Separate customer requests from underlying problems and build products that generalize across retailers. 
Partner with customers during early deployments and use real-world usage to rapidly improve the product. 

Drive outcomes, not feature delivery

Define clear measures of success for the capabilities you own. 
Understand whether products are actually changing planner behavior and improving retail decisions. 
Make trade-offs across usability, sophistication, autonomy, explainability, and speed. 
Operate with high ownership across product, commercial, and customer outcomes. 

What We're Looking For

6+ years of Product Management experience, ideally building complex B2B, enterprise, data, planning, optimization, or decision-support products. 
Strong understanding of retail planning, particularly within Hardlines and/or Softlines retail. 
Experience working on problems involving assortment, inventory, allocation, replenishment, merchandising, pricing, forecasting, or adjacent planning domains is highly valuable. 
Ability to understand complex business systems and reduce them into clear product abstractions. 
Strong product judgment. You can distinguish between recreating an existing workflow and designing a materially better way of solving the problem. 
Comfortable working with data-heavy products and collaborating closely with engineering, data science, and AI/ML teams. 
Excellent customer discovery skills. You can go several layers deeper than what a user initially asks for. 
Strong written and verbal communication. 
Comfortable operating in an environment with significant ambiguity, high autonomy, and a high bar for execution. 

We'd Be Particularly Excited If

You've built products used by merchandise planners, inventory planners, allocators, buyers, or other retail planning teams. 
You've worked inside a major retailer or closely with enterprise retail customers. 
You've built AI-native or agentic products rather than simply adding AI features to an existing application. 
You naturally question whether a workflow needs to exist at all before optimizing it. 
You enjoy domains where product management requires learning the underlying business deeply enough to debate with experts. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you should be able to:

Become one of Lyric's internal experts on Hardlines and Softlines retail planning. 
Own and materially advance a meaningful portion of Lyric's Retail Planning product. 
Build trusted relationships with sophisticated retail customers and planners. 
Ship products that replace meaningful amounts of manual planning work, not merely make those workflows slightly faster. 
Establish repeatable patterns for how AI agents and human planners collaborate, moving Lyric progressively toward autonomous retail planning.

Roles & Responsibilities

About Availity 

Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity, so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

About Availity India

About The Role

Availity is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, discovery, delivery and measurable outcomes for the User & Organization (U&O) Platform, a foundational platform layer that enables shared identity, organization management, user administration and access capabilities across Availity products. 
This is a product leader who can connect customers and market needs with enterprise platform strategy. Role Mandate 

Turn identity, organization and access management into a scalable shared platform that reduces product-by-product duplication, strengthens trust, and accelerates enterprise growth.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will include: 

A clear, evidence-based U&O platform strategy that aligns executive stakeholders, delivery teams and consuming product teams. 
Increased adoption and reuse of shared identity, organization and access-management capabilities. 
Reduced duplication of identity, user-administration and access-management capabilities across Availity products. 
Reduced effort and lead time required for products to integrate with shared U&O services. 
Measurable improvement in user and administrator journeys, including registration, onboarding, sign-in, account recovery and access administration. 
Improved customer and administrator satisfaction with identity, organization and access-management experiences. 
Stronger access governance, assurance alignment, traceability, auditability, and policy consistency across the platform. 
Improved platform reliability, scalability, security, and release predictability. 
Successful migration of priority products and customers to share U&O capabilities with controlled customer and operational risk. 
Increased visibility into users, organizations, affiliations, roles, entitlements, and product access. 
Reduced manual administration, avoidable support demand, and operational complexity. 
Roadmap and investment decisions that are demonstrably tied to customer outcomes, enterprise value, risk reduction, and long-term platform health. 

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications 

12+ years of progressive product leadership experience, with a demonstrated track record of defining product strategy, influencing investment decisions and driving measurable business outcomes across the product lifecycle from discovery and market validation through scale and optimization. 
Proven expertise in customer-centric product strategy, including market and user research, vision development, portfolio roadmap planning, executive stakeholder alignment and outcome-based prioritization. 
Demonstrated ability to balance customer value, business impact, risk, security, compliance, and technical investment when making product decisions. 
3+ years leading Identity and Access Management, Customer Identity, User Administration, Organizational Management or Enterprise Governance platforms, with ownership of strategic capabilities that serve as foundational business enablers. 
Deep understanding of digital identity, authentication and trust frameworks. 
Hands-on product experience delivering production-scale identity experiences aligned with NIST SP 800-63 Identity Assurance Levels and Authentication Assurance Levels. Familiarity with these standards is considered a core competency for the role rather than an optional qualification. 
Demonstrated leadership in defining and evolving enterprise authorization and access-governance strategies. 
Experience defining scalable Role-Based Access Control models within complex, multi-tenant SaaS ecosystems. 
Experience driving product decisions across identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, delegated administration, organizational hierarchies, entitlement governance, compliance and platform scalability. 
Experience delivering platform capabilities that serve multiple products, customer segments, or business workflows. 
Proven ability to define reusable platform capabilities while balancing legitimate product-specific and customer-specific requirements. 
Experience leading customer and product migrations from legacy or fragmented capabilities to shared platform services. 
Proven success partnering with Engineering, Security, Architecture, Compliance, Operations and customer-facing teams to deliver enterprise platform capabilities. 
Strong understanding of platform reliability, scalability, security, privacy, observability, and operational readiness.

Role: Product Manager - AI Services

Excited to define technology that powers an entire portfolio of products, not just a single application? 
Interested in building the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform? 


If so, we'd love to meet you.

Why Esko? 

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.

By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.

About The Role

As Product Manager for AI Services, you will own the product lifecycle for a shared foundation of AI capabilities that Esko's internal teams build on rather than re-invent - enabling them to solve customer problems that were previously out of reach with optimal speed and efficiency.

Cross-functional collaboration sits at the core of the role. You will coach internal teams, consolidate their needs to find common ground, work with technical and design stakeholders to agree the best approach, and document clear, testable requirements that are reviewed and approved before development begins. Ongoing success management is central: keeping services aligned with evolving team and customer needs while maintaining a generalized approach and backwards compatibility, and growing capabilities in line with advances in technology and market expectations. You will track adoption and key performance metrics to demonstrate impact and identify where more focus is needed.

As a key member of the Esko AI team, you will also help shape the strategic vision for Esko's AI initiatives through brainstorming, thought leadership, customer discussions and events.

What You Will Do

Own and prioritize the product backlog for AI Services – a shared collection of common AI capabilities leveraged by Esko product and engineering teams.
Proactively gather needs from cross-functional product teams and turn them into clear, well-scoped requirements for the Esko AI engineering teams.
Act as a bridge between Esko AI and other cross-functional teams - product, engineering, and commercial – to ensure their success in building AI-powered capabilities that deliver on the intended customer value.
Help other teams to bootstrap their own AI initiatives on top of the shared capabilities: clarifying what already exists, what needs to be built, and how to get started.
Weigh competing requests from multiple stakeholders against the long-term company strategy and priorities, while documenting risks and expected trade-offs.
Define and maintain adoption / success metrics for the shared capabilities - and use them to continually re-prioritize the backlog and indicate risks and areas of additional focus.
Communicate roadmap, priorities, and trade-offs clearly across engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders.


What We Are Looking For

At least 5 years’ experience in a Software Product Management role, preferably including ownership of a platform, API or other shared-services product used across multiple internal teams.
Undergraduate or master’s degree in computer science or related discipline.
Native or fluent proficiency in English.
Experience initiating, deploying, and scaling AI-powered capabilities in production, with a track record of managing the development cycle from proof-of-concepts or early-stage ideas into production capabilities that other teams depend on.
Experience acting as a liaison in a large, global organization with multiple cross-functional teams - gathering and distilling requirements from varied stakeholders, aligning competing priorities, and driving toward a successful shared outcome.
Strong product management fundamentals: backlog ownership and refinement, roadmap creation & communication, and the ability to write clear, unambiguous requirements for engineering to build and test against.
Comfort operating at the boundary between a platform team and the product teams that consume it, balancing shared needs and central objectives against individual team priorities and timelines.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to work fluently with both technical and business stakeholders alike.


Preferred Experience

Teams across the business ship AI-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation of AI Services, rather than “re-inventing the wheel”.

About Daloopa:
Daloopa is the leading provider of AI-powered fundamental data for institutional investors. Headquartered in New York, with a growing team in India, Daloopa's proprietary platform sources, structures, and distributes one of the most comprehensive and accurate financial datasets in the market, helping investors accelerate research, financial modeling, and decision-making.
Trusted by hedge funds, private equity firms, mutual funds, corporates, and investment banks globally, Daloopa recently secured $47 million in Series C funding, bringing total funding to over $100 million. This investment will accelerate the company's mission of powering the next generation of AI-driven financial workflows.
At Daloopa, we are driven by our values: Obsess over the Customer, Raise the Bar, Be Intensely Proactive, and No BS. Joining us means being part of a high-performance culture where innovation, ownership, and impact go hand in hand.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the platform where humans and AI work together on live financial data — the review and feedback layer that supplements our AI extraction systems.
Every correction, override, and judgment call a human analyst makes in this product is a signal. Your job is to design the experience so that signal gets captured cleanly and routed back into the systems that need it: better context for the model at the point of decision, structured feedback loops, and inputs that improve accuracy of our data. As coverage expands into new regions, document types, and event types, this layer is what keeps quality improving across this expanding perimeter.
You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, and Product leadership to design review workflows that are fast for the analyst and help tune AI, and to build the instrumentation that turns human review into a compounding asset.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who is deeply technical, highly execution-oriented, and excited about building the human-AI interface for a real-world AI system at scale.

Key Responsibilities:
Own the roadmap for the review and feedback experience, covering how analysts see model context, make corrections, and resolve disagreements between AI output and ground truth.
Design context management into the workflow — surfacing the right source documents, prior decisions, and model reasoning at the moment an analyst needs to judge or correct an output, so review speed doesn't trade off against review quality.
Build the feedback and tuning loop end to end: capture structured signal from every human correction, route it to the AI/ML team in a form they can act on, and close the loop by measuring whether it changed downstream accuracy.
Partner with Engineering and AI/ML to define what needs to be reviewed, what the ideal review experience is, and how it endures with future AI model updates.
Instrument the full workflow from document to reviewed datapoint, with a single metric the team can rally around for review speed and error rate.
Collaborate cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, and Operations to align priorities, execute quickly, and deliver measurable business impact.
Stay current on advancements in AI/LLMs and apply emerging capabilities — particularly around human-in-the-loop tuning and RLHF-style feedback — thoughtfully into platform strategy and execution.

Skills and Qualifications
We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager with 3+ years of experience building AI/ML product features, or workflow/tooling products, and 8+ years of PM experience at Series B or later companies.
You'll be a strong fit if you:
Have experience owning complex platform or workflow products end-to-end, ideally ones where humans review or correct AI/ML output.
Have worked closely with AI/ML systems, LLM workflows, or human-in-the-loop annotation and review tooling.
Understand the mechanics of feedback loops: how to capture a human correction as structured signal, and how that signal should reach a model or tuning pipeline.
Can design for two audiences at once — the analyst doing the review and the AI/ML system consuming what the review produces — without over-indexing on either.
Can comfortably work with highly technical teams and participate in architecture and system design discussions.
Have strong product judgment and can balance review speed, data quality, and operational complexity.
Are highly analytical and comfortable balancing use of data and domain-specific intuition to drive prioritization and decision-making.
Have experience designing experimentation frameworks, benchmark evaluations, or feedback loop systems.
Possess strong written and verbal communication skills and can simplify complex technical concepts.
Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with high ownership and autonomy.

Preferred Qualifications
Have shipped, as an IC, at least 1 AI-native product or agentic workflow or hybrid ML/LLM system into production at 1K+ DAU or transactions per day scale.
Shipped at least 1 human-in-loop review, annotation, or QA tooling product feature to at least 1K+ DAU.
Familiarity with SQL, experimentation frameworks, and product analytics tools.
Experience scaling review or QA workflows across multiple workflows, geographies, or datasets.
Background in B2B SaaS, AI infrastructure, or FinTech products.

Why Join Daloopa?
Impact at scale: Your work directly supports some of the world’s most demanding investment teams.
Culture of excellence: Be part of a team that values accuracy, speed, and raising the bar every day.
Growth opportunities: Gain exposure to global capital markets while sharpening your financial and analytical skills.
Dynamic workplace: A culture built on ownership, transparency, and collaboration, where every contribution matters.

Comprehensive Health Insurance
Employee well-being program with 24x7 medical assistance
Work-life balance with flexible policies

About Daloopa
Daloopa is the leading provider of AI-powered fundamental data for institutional investors. Headquartered in New York, with a growing team in India, Daloopa's proprietary platform sources, structures, and distributes one of the most comprehensive and accurate financial datasets in the market, helping investors accelerate research, financial modeling, and decision-making.
Trusted by hedge funds, private equity firms, mutual funds, corporates, and investment banks globally, Daloopa recently secured $47 million in Series C funding, bringing total funding to over $100 million. This investment will accelerate the company's mission of powering the next generation of AI-driven financial workflows.
At Daloopa, we are driven by our values: Obsess over the Customer, Raise the Bar, Be Intensely Proactive, and No BS. Joining us means being part of a high-performance culture where innovation, ownership, and impact go hand in hand.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager for our AI-powered automated extraction platform the core system powering automated extraction as we scale across global coverage.
This role sits at the intersection of LLM systems, native AI/ML systems, experimentation, and product strategy. You will own the evolution of our native extraction stack, ensuring the platform remains reliable, scalable, and measurable as we expand into new regions, document types, and workflows.
You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, and Product leadership to improve extraction quality and performance, scale experimentation velocity, and operationalize human-in-the-loop workflows.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who is deeply technical, highly execution-oriented, and excited about building real-world AI systems at scale.

Key Responsibilities
Own the roadmap for native AI/ML stack for our AI-powered extraction platform, focused on scalability, reliability, and quality.
Ensure extraction quality remains reliable and robust as we expand across regions and document types by building strong benchmarking, guardrails, and quality-check systems.
Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams to drive experimentation, optimize routing across ML and LLM systems, and scale successful capabilities into production.
Collaborate cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, and Operations to align priorities, execute quickly, and deliver measurable business impact.
Stay current on advancements in AI/LLMs and apply emerging capabilities thoughtfully into platform strategy and execution.

Skills and Qualifications
We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager with 3+ years of experience building AI/ML product features, or workflow/tooling products, and 8+ years of PM experience at Series B or later companies.
You’ll be a strong fit if you:
Have experience owning complex platform or infrastructure products end-to-end.
Have worked closely with AI/ML systems, LLM workflows, data pipelines, or automation platforms.
Understand the nuances of reliability, observability, experimentation, and evaluation systems for AI products.
Can comfortably work with highly technical teams and participate in architecture and system design discussions.
Have strong product judgment and can balance speed, quality, scalability, and operational complexity.
Are highly analytical and comfortable using data to drive prioritization and decision-making.
Have experience designing experimentation frameworks, benchmark evaluations, or feedback loop systems.
Possess strong written and verbal communication skills and can simplify complex technical concepts.
Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with high ownership and autonomy.

Preferred Qualifications
Have shipped, as an IC, at least 1 AI-native product or agentic workflow or hybrid ML/LLM system into production at 1K+ DAU or transactions per day scale.
Experience in hedge funds, sell-side research, investment banking, or investment management in general is a plus
Experience with LLM-powered products, AI agents, or hybrid ML/LLM systems.
Familiarity with SQL, experimentation frameworks, and product analytics tools.
Experience scaling automation systems across multiple workflows, geographies, or datasets.
Background in B2B SaaS, AI infrastructure, or FinTech products.

Why Join Daloopa?
Impact at scale: Your work directly supports some of the world’s most demanding investment teams.
Culture of excellence: Be part of a team that values accuracy, speed, and raising the bar every day.
Growth opportunities: Gain exposure to global capital markets while sharpening your financial and analytical skills.
Dynamic workplace: A culture built on ownership, transparency, and collaboration, where every contribution matters.

Employee Benefits
Comprehensive Health Insurance
Employee well-being program with 24x7 medical assistance
Work-life balance with flexible policies

What You’ll Do

Define Product Vision & Roadmap: Own the product strategy, roadmap, and core positioning for Korza.ai’s ML platform, enterprise AI products, and AI control plane. 
Drive Consulting-to-Product Transition: Partner with enterprise client teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable, multi-tenant platform features and reusable AI products. 
Architect AI-First User Experiences: Translate complex LLM, RAG, and agentic workflows into intuitive product requirements (PRDs), specifications, and functional end-to-end user journeys. 
Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate directly with AI/ML engineers, technical project managers, designers, and business leaders to drive rapid, high-impact product releases. 
Data & Metrics Ownership: Define and track product performance metrics (adoption, latency, task completion accuracy, retention) to continuously iterate and optimize product utility. 

What We’re Looking For

Product Management Mastery: 5+ years of product management experience shipping enterprise software, SaaS, developer tools, or data platforms. 
Technical & Architecture Depth: Strong understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, enterprise SDLC, and backend infrastructure. 
AI/ML Technical Exposure: Functional expertise or direct experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG frameworks, prompt systems, or agent-based workflows. 
Enterprise Product Delivery: Proven track record of taking products from 0-to-1 and managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise requirements. 
Problem-Solving & Agility: Ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, prioritize ruthlessly, and thrive in an ambitious, fast-paced hub environment. 

Why Join Us

Real AI Product Impact: Work on genuine AI products and complex systems that serve global Fortune 100–1000 clients across the US, UK, and Europe. 
Shape the SDLC Future: Participate in defining the future of AI-driven software development by turning real-world enterprise learnings into next-generation AI platforms. 
Core Ownership: Be a pivotal member of our core hub in Bangalore, taking deep ownership in a high-growth, high-talent-density engineering environment.

About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people 

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact 

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About The Role

HighLevel is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and evolve Custom Objects - a foundational part of our CRM platform. 

Businesses operate around more than Contacts, Companies, and Opportunities. A real estate business may need Properties, an automotive business Vehicles, and an insurance business Policies. Custom Objects allow customers to model these unique business entities, define relationships between them, and use that data across workflows, reporting, integrations, and other HighLevel products.

We're looking for a technically strong Product Manager with deep understanding of databases, data modeling, APIs, and integrations who can work closely with Engineering to take this platform to the next level.

What You'll Own 

Define the product strategy and roadmap for Custom Objects and the evolution of HighLevel's CRM data model. 
Build scalable capabilities for creating custom entities, fields, records, relationships, associations, and permissions. 
Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on data models, schemas, APIs, scalability, data integrity, performance, and platform extensibility . 
Make Custom Objects a first-class citizen across Workflows, Reporting, Contacts, Companies, Opportunities, Forms, Integrations, AI, and other HighLevel products . 
Evolve our API, webhook, import/export, and synchronization capabilities so customers and developers can reliably integrate Custom Objects with external systems. 
Translate complex customer requirements into reusable platform primitives rather than one-off solutions . 
Drive the product lifecycle from customer discovery and technical design through delivery, adoption, and iteration. 
Define and own success metrics across adoption, usage, API consumption, platform reliability, and customer outcomes. 

What We're Looking For 

7+ years of Product Management experience , with significant experience building platform, CRM, data, developer, infrastructure, or integration products. 
Strong understanding of relational databases, entity-relationship modeling, schemas, metadata, and one-to-one / one-to-many / many-to-many relationships . 
Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, data synchronization, integrations, imports/exports, and data mapping . 
Ability to reason about data integrity, scalability, performance, backward compatibility, and system-level trade-offs . 
Proven ability to work deeply with Engineering and Architecture on technically complex products. 
Strong product judgment - able to simplify sophisticated platform capabilities into experiences that are intuitive for SMB customers. 
Ability to operate in ambiguous problem spaces and align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and GTM teams around a clear direction. 

Strong Plus 

Experience building products in one or more of the following areas:

CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Dynamics 
Flexible data platforms such as Airtable, Notion, or Coda 
API or developer platforms 
Integration/iPaaS platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or Tray.io 
Database, ERP, CDP, data infrastructure, or systems-of-record products 

Hands-on familiarity with SQL, APIs, data modeling, or integration architecture is highly valuable.

What Great Looks Like 

You're someone who doesn't just ask:

"What features should we build?"

You ask:

"What capability or primitive should exist in the platform so this problem is solved consistently across the CRM, APIs, Workflows, Reporting, Integrations, and AI?"

You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to go deep with engineers, understand architectural trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and jointly arrive at scalable solutions. 

The decisions you make will help shape how HighLevel models and connects customer data across the entire platform.

Usage expectations and downstream dependencies
