jobs.sourceTitle: Senior Product Manager – Activation & Onboarding, Commerce
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
About Wingify
Wingify is building an Agentic Experience Optimization Platform that brings experimentation, personalization, behavioral insights, commerce optimization, feature management, and customer engagement together on a shared data foundation.
At the heart of the platform is Wingz, our intelligence engine that continuously understands customer behavior, decides what is most relevant, acts in the moment, and learns from the outcome.
Within our Commerce Product Tribe, activation is where this journey begins.
Our enterprise customers have complex, heterogeneous product catalogs and data sources. Getting them live requires connecting these systems, structuring their data, and making the setup simple enough that increasingly AI—not manual configuration—does the heavy lifting.
That's where you come in.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager – Activation & Onboarding to own the journey from signed contract to first measurable customer value for our Commerce products.
You will own the product experience and roadmap across technical integration, catalog onboarding, data structuring, configuration, and activation. Your goal is simple: make it dramatically faster and easier for enterprise customers to get live and see value.
This is an impact-driven role. Success isn't measured by how many features you ship, but by whether you improve metrics such as:
Time to first value
Activation and onboarding completion rates
Catalog integration success
Drop-off at different onboarding stages
Data quality and integration reliability
Support effort required to get customers live

You'll work closely with Engineering, Data, GTM, CSM, TSM and TSE teams, as well as directly with enterprise customers and their technical teams.
You'll also have a significant opportunity to use AI and automation to rethink how enterprise onboarding works—from catalog mapping and configuration to troubleshooting and error resolution.

What You'll Own
Own the activation and onboarding product roadmap end-to-end, from customer kickoff through first live recommendation and measurable value.
Define and track activation KPIs including time-to-value, activation rate, integration completion, catalog health and onboarding drop-offs.
Partner with Engineering and Data teams on API integrations, catalog/feed ingestion, data schemas and integration architecture across sources such as BigQuery, feeds and direct APIs.
Identify and remove friction across catalog connection, data mapping, structuring, validation, synchronization and error handling.
Simplify technical onboarding for both technical and non-technical users through better UX, automation and self-service experiences.
Explore and ship AI-powered capabilities such as automatic catalog structure detection, AI-assisted field mapping, natural-language configuration, intelligent defaults and proactive integration troubleshooting.
Conduct structured discovery with customers, CSMs, TSMs and TSEs to understand where onboarding breaks down and quantify the impact of solving those problems.
Translate the needs of international enterprise customers—including multi-market, multi-catalog and non-standard data structures—into clear product requirements and evaluation criteria.
Own experimentation and continuous improvement of onboarding flows through instrumentation, funnel analysis and customer feedback.
Monitor integration reliability, data quality and activation performance, and proactively address regressions.
Clearly communicate product capabilities, limitations and AI-driven automation to customers and internal stakeholders, building confidence and trust in the experience.

What We're Looking For
4–8 years of Product Management experience, ideally building integration, activation/onboarding or data-intensive B2B products.
Experience working with products involving APIs, data pipelines, product catalogs, feeds, search, recommendations or personalization.
Proven experience shipping products that simplify technical onboarding or enterprise integrations, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment.
Strong ability to work with Engineering and Data teams on topics such as APIs, data schemas, catalog/feed formats and integration architecture.
You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be technically curious, comfortable going deep, and able to challenge technical trade-offs from a customer and business perspective.
A genuine interest in using AI to reduce product friction and automate workflows, with good judgment about where automation creates value and where human control is still important.
E-commerce or retail experience is a strong plus, particularly with product catalogs, feeds, merchandising, search, recommendations or personalization.
Experience working with international, multi-market or multi-language products is a plus.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are required.
French is a plus.

What Great Looks Like
Product Craft
You can take an ambiguous integration or onboarding problem and turn it into a clear, outcome-driven product roadmap.
You understand that AI is a means to remove friction, not the product objective itself.
You can work effectively with Engineering and Data teams on complex technical problems without needing to be the deepest technical expert in the room.
You have strong product intuition for what makes an integration genuinely easy—not just easy in a demo.

Discovery & Execution
You use a combination of customer interviews, funnel data, product analytics and operational insights to identify the highest-impact problems.
You can translate customer pain points into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
You drive execution with clarity across product development, QA, experimentation, documentation and launch.
You continuously measure activation and time-to-value and use those insights to improve the onboarding journey.

Business & Stakeholder Management
You work effectively across GTM, Sales, CSM, TSM, TSE, Operations, Engineering and Data.
You can explain complex technical concepts in simple language to customers and business stakeholders.
You build trust by being clear about what the product—and its AI capabilities—can and cannot do.
You prioritize based on customer impact, activation outcomes and business value, rather than simply chasing new technology.

Autonomy & Mindset
You take ownership, make decisions and keep things moving in ambiguous environments.
You bring people along, challenge assumptions constructively and maintain a high bar for quality.
You are comfortable operating across international teams, cultures and time zones.
You combine rigor and ambition with a collaborative, low-ego approach.

Why This Role?
This is an opportunity to work on a high-impact product problem at the intersection of Product, AI, Data and Commerce.
You'll have the opportunity to fundamentally rethink how enterprise customers integrate complex product data and get value from a sophisticated commerce platform—moving from manual, technical onboarding toward an intelligent, AI-assisted activation experience.
If you're excited by complex product problems, enterprise customers, data-heavy systems and using AI to make products dramatically simpler, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a hands-on role. You will write specifications, interrogate data, define validation logic, and sit in UAT. You will not be managing a team of BAs on day one, though you will set the standard the rest of the organisation follows.

What You Will Own

Product direction

  • Own the roadmap and backlog for an assigned product area (chart review AI, encounter/EDGE submissions, RAF analytics, or RADV audit readiness).
  • Translate CMS and HHS regulatory change — model version updates, submission deadlines, RADV protocol changes — into product decisions, sequencing, and release planning.
  • Define success measures for each feature (coder throughput, RAF accuracy, submission acceptance rates, audit defensibility) and track outcomes after release.
  • Partner with founders, sales, and implementation on customer discovery, demos, pilots, and beta feedback loops.

Requirements and domain logic

  • Elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements for risk adjustment, HCC analytics, and submission workflows.
  • Write user stories, use cases, process flows, data mapping documents, business rules, and acceptance criteria that an engineer can build from without needing a second conversation.
  • Specify CMS-HCC model logic (including V24 and V28), HHS-HCC logic for ACA, RAF calculation, diagnosis eligibility, and filtering rules in enough detail to be implemented and tested.
  • Define file-level behaviour for X12 837 I/P/D, TA1, 999, 277CA, MAO-002, MAO-004, MMR, MOR, and ACA EDGE Server XML files including enrolment, medical, pharmacy, and supplemental diagnosis submissions.
  • Specify reconciliation logic that traces rejected, dropped, or failed records back to source claims, encounters, charts, and member data.

Technical partnership

  • Work directly with data and AI engineers on data models, pipeline behaviour, and edge cases; read and write SQL to validate what the platform actually produces.
  • Define evaluation criteria for AI outputs — code suggestion precision and recall, MEAT evidence quality, hallucination controls, human-in-the-loop review steps, and audit trail requirements.
  • Contribute to API and integration design for EHR, coding platform, and payer data exchange.
  • Own UAT planning and regression scenarios aligned to CMS model files, business rules, and real customer data conditions.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 6–12 years in US healthcare, including at least 3 years in a product management, product owner, or lead BA capacity on a healthcare data or SaaS product.
  • Deep working knowledge of risk adjustment for Medicare Advantage and/or ACA Marketplace: CMS-HCC and/or HHS-HCC models, RAF scoring, HCC mapping, and the diagnosis-to-payment relationship.
  • Strong command of healthcare claims data — ICD-10-CM, CPT/HCPCS, claim frequency codes, place of service, dates of service, provider and rendering identifiers, and the fields that determine diagnosis eligibility.
  • Practical experience with encounter data submission (RAPS/EDPS) or ACA EDGE server submissions, including response file handling and error resolution.
  • Demonstrated ability to write specifications that engineering teams can build from: business rules, data mappings, state transitions, and acceptance criteria.
  • SQL proficiency sufficient to profile data, reproduce defects, and validate calculations independently.
  • Comfortable in a startup environment — self-directed, proactive, and able to work with US stakeholders across time zones with strong written and spoken English.

Strongly preferred

  • Direct exposure to RADV or HHS-RADV audits — sampling, medical record retrieval, coder validation, discrepancy handling, or extrapolation methodology.
  • Experience shipping AI or NLP-enabled products, and defining how model output is measured, reviewed, and governed.
  • Background as a certified coder (CPC, CRC, CCS) or clinical documentation specialist, or close working experience with coding and CDI teams.
  • Prior work at a payer, risk adjustment vendor, or provider-side risk organisation.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, PHI handling, and audit trail expectations in production systems.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: fluent in our data model and product lines; owning the backlog for one product area; requirements accepted by engineering with minimal rework.
  • Six months: shipped features that measurably improve coder throughput or submission acceptance rates; owning the CMS/HHS regulatory change pipeline into the product.
  • Twelve months: the reference point internally for risk adjustment logic, and a trusted voice in customer conversations alongside the founders.

Team Overview
The Managed File Transfer (MFT) team is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and compliant data exchange capabilities that support critical business operations across TransUnion. MFT serves as a foundational platform enabling customers, partners, and internal teams to securely transfer and process data while meeting regulatory, security, and operational requirements.

The team is currently leading several strategic modernization initiatives, including large-scale customer migrations, cloud transformation, platform modernization, operational excellence improvements, and compliance-driven programs. Success requires close collaboration across Product, Engineering, Operations, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Security, and Business stakeholders.

This role sits at the center of those efforts, helping translate business priorities into execution plans while ensuring successful delivery of customer-facing outcomes. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
Role Overview And Core Responsibilities
We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Technical Product Manager (TPM) to lead the strategic execution and adoption of the Managed File Transfer (MFT) platform.

This is not a traditional product management role. Success requires a unique combination of product management, program management, and project management disciplines. The ideal candidate can define priorities, drive execution, orchestrate complex initiatives, and hold teams accountable for commitments.

You will be responsible for leading cross-functional efforts that span multiple engineering teams, operational groups, customer-facing organizations, and external stakeholders. A significant portion of the role involves driving large-scale migration programs where success depends on coordinating dozens of parallel workstreams, removing blockers, managing competing priorities, and ensuring customers successfully adopt platform capabilities.

The right candidate is a strong influencer who is comfortable challenging assumptions, escalating issues when necessary, and creating accountability across organizations. They must be capable of bringing structure to ambiguity and relentlessly driving initiatives to successful completion.

The Dairy Product Manager will play a key role in strengthening and growing De Heus Indias dairy business.

We are looking for a business-oriented and field-driven dairy specialist who can connect market and customer needs with nutrition, formulation, product positioning and commercial execution.

This role is not only about technical product management. It requires someone who understands dairy farmers and the Indian market, can translate technical knowledge into practical solutions, and can motivate and strengthen our commercial organization.

The ultimate goal is to build stronger product competitiveness, sustainable volume growth, improved NAV and profitability, while developing stronger technical capabilities within the organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage the dairy product portfolio in line with market needs and De Heus strategy.
  • Understand the needs of dairy farmers, dealers and customers and translate them into practical product concepts, feeding solutions and technical advice.
  • Work closely with Nutrition and Formulation teams to improve product performance, consistency and cost competitiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to improve COGS and formulation flexibility without compromising product quality or animal performance.
  • Support the Commercial team with product positioning, technical selling and clear customer value propositions.
  • Regularly visit farms, dealers and markets to understand customer needs, competitor activities and changing market conditions.
  • Be hands-on and practical in the field, including farm troubleshooting and direct customer support when required.
  • Benchmark De Heus dairy products against key competitors in terms of performance, specification, price and customer value.
  • Develop and strengthen technical tools, product claims, proof points and practical concepts to support sales growth.
  • Support new product development and continuous improvement of existing products based on market opportunities and customer feedback.
  • Work closely with Purchasing, Quality, Operations, Nutrition and Formulation teams to identify and evaluate new raw materials and by-products that can strengthen product and cost competitiveness.
  • Provide technical training and coaching to Sales teams, Senior Consultants, dealers and key customers.
  • Motivate and strengthen the technical and commercial capabilities of the field organization.
  • Support major customer visits, farm troubleshooting and important technical discussions.
  • Monitor dairy market trends, milk economics, feed trends, competitor activities and farmer profitability.
  • Maintain close communication with the De Heus Asia Hub and Global Ruminant team, sharing market insights and applying relevant De Heus concepts and expertise in India.
  • Actively embrace, adapt and implement De Heus concepts, philosophy and technical know-how in the Indian market.
  • Contribute directly to the dairy business strategy, volume growth, NAV improvement and profitability.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong technical background in dairy nutrition, ruminant nutrition or animal nutrition.
  • Solid experience and practical understanding of the Indian dairy feed market.
  • Good understanding of dairy farmers, dealer networks and commercial dynamics.
  • Ability to connect technical knowledge with business and commercial realities.
  • Strong understanding of feed formulation, raw materials and cost competitiveness.
  • Practical, hands-on and field-oriented mindset someone who is comfortable working directly with farmers, animals, feed and field teams.
  • Strong commercial mindset, with a clear focus on customer value and profitable growth.
  • Proactive attitude and strong ownership able to identify issues and opportunities and drive actions without waiting for direction.
  • Strong communication, influencing and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to train, coach and motivate Sales teams and Senior Consultants.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Commercial, Nutrition, Formulation, Purchasing, Quality and Operations.
  • Strong problem-solving capability and willingness to take responsibility for results.
  • Willingness to learn, embrace and apply De Heus concepts and philosophy.
  • Good working English communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with the Asia Hub and Global teams.

Preferred Background

  • Degree in Animal Nutrition, Veterinary Science, Dairy Science, Animal Science or a related field.
  • Several years of relevant experience in the dairy feed / animal nutrition industry.
  • Experience with a leading feed, nutrition or dairy company would be an advantage.
  • Strong field experience working directly with dairy farms, customers and commercial teams.
  • Existing network within the Indian dairy industry would be highly valuable.
  • Experience in technical training, product management or commercial technical support would be an advantage.

Key Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Improvement in dairy product competitiveness.
  • Sustainable improvement in dairy volume, NAV and profitability.
  • Stronger technical and commercial support to the Sales organization.
  • Successful product and formulation improvements.
  • Improvement in COGS competitiveness and formulation flexibility.
  • Better customer retention and conversion.

Role Overview:

This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort — the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market — with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve.

About The Role

Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?

At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the Head of Product and Engineering, you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms.

In this dual-hatted role, you will:

Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms: Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms.

Serve as the India Site Lead: Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site.

This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Strategy ,Platform Unification and Product Management
Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform.
Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency.
AI & Automation Integration: Partner with AI/ML research teams to embed intelligent routing, automated document processing, and machine learning-driven decision support systems into the core workflow engine.
Technical Governance: Establish and enforce robust architectural standards, API designs, and data schemas that ensure long-term platform extensibility and maintainability.
Product leadership: Thought leader and ability to wear the product hat. Ability to drive strategic product decision along with key stakeholders
Global Engineering Leadership & Execution
Manage Globally Distributed Teams: Lead, inspire, and scale a multi-disciplinary engineering organization(75+)
Foster Engineering Excellence: Establish rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, tracing, logging) to ensure 99.999% platform availability.
Operational & Financial Management: Oversee financial planning, resource allocation, vendor management, and operational budgets for your global engineering organisation.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Risk, and senior business executives to align engineering roadmaps with business outcomes.
India Site Leadership
Site Strategy & Growth: Act as the senior executive and site lead for the regional engineering hub in India. Drive local talent acquisition, retention, and career development programs.
Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies.
Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies.

Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture

We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack:

Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs
Frontend & Workflows: React, Angular, TypeScript, Modern BPMN/Workflow Engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda, Flowable)
Data & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
Cloud & Infrastructure: Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS, Service Mesh (Istio)
AI/ML & Analytics: Multi-LLM integrations via secure internal gateways, Vector Databases, Python-based ML pipelines

What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)

Basic Qualifications:

Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications.
Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in designing and operating high-availability, low-latency, and highly secure distributed systems at massive scale.
Global Leadership: Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams of 80+ engineers, including direct management of engineering managers and principal architects.
Site Leadership: Proven experience leading a regional engineering site or hub, with a strong track record of building local talent pipelines and fostering a strong engineering culture.

Preferred Qualifications:

Domain Knowledge: Experience in compliance, sanctions, transaction risk, anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, or high-scale transactional risk systems is highly desirable but not mandatory. We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience.
Workflow & BPMN Expertise: Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda) and complex state-machine design.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

Why Join Citi?

Unprecedented Scale & Impact: We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk.
True Autonomy: You will have the mandate, budget, and executive backing to make critical architectural and organizational decisions to achieve our platform unification goals.
Modern Developer Ecosystem: Leverage Citi's state-of-the-art internal developer platforms, including our secure GenAI gateway and modern serverless application frameworks, to accelerate delivery.

And many more reasons…

Establish the principles, product standards, and architectural guardrails that guide the evolution of the Control Plane in partnership with engineering leadership.

Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

About The Insight Program

Who are we solving for?

We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.

What are we solving for?

Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.

For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.

Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.

With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.

Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.

Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.

Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.

Most of what breaks in a sixty-person ed-tech product isn't the big stuff - it's the enrolment flow that confuses a school admin, the report card export that half of teachers never find, the setting that three customers a week ask support to explain. That's the layer this role owns. You'd spend your first months mostly listening: sitting in on support escalations and school onboarding calls, reading through user feedback, and starting to notice which small frictions actually cost renewals.
From there you'd move into writing lightweight specs for fixes and small features, working with a couple of engineers to get them built, and checking after launch whether they actually helped - not assuming they did because they shipped. You'd also help run the intake for feature requests coming in from the sales and customer-success teams, since right now that list lives in someone's inbox and nowhere else.
The company - a sixty-person ed-tech business selling to schools and colleges - has partnered with Flexiple, which helps companies like this one build out their India teams, to hire its first Associate Product Manager.
0-3 years of experience; a stint in product, customer success, or business analysis at a software company is ideal
Comfortable writing a clear one-page spec without hand-holding
Some familiarity with a tool like Excel, SQL, or a product-analytics dashboard
Patient enough to talk to actual teachers and school admins and take their feedback seriously
To apply, send your profile through Flexiple - we'll get back with next steps within a few days.

At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

7+ years of experience in product analysis, digital assets, financial technology, blockchain infrastructure, tokenization or capital markets with demonstrated proficiency architecting blockchain solutions and DeFi applications and comprehensive knowledge of blockchain technology stack
Strong understanding of digital asset market structure, tokenization, stablecoins, distributed ledger technologies and digital market infrastructure along with experience in deriving or assessing digital asset risks for blockchain platforms, smart contracts, blockchain oracles and wallet infrastructure
Product management experience and knowledge of smart contract development, with Solidity, DAML, Rust or Canton Network architecture certifications preferred
Working exposure to structured and unstructured data sources, including on-chain and off-chain data
Experience supporting pilots, integrations or multi-stakeholder initiatives in a build-test-scale environment
Ability to translate emerging market developments and business objectives into strategic initiatives and executable priorities
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical, analytical, commercial and risk stakeholders

Education

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience in finance, economics, business, technology, engineering, data analytics or a related field

Advance digital asset product capabilities that deliver credit-relevant insights across evolving financial markets.

Monitor developments across digital assets, tokenization, stablecoins and emerging market infrastructure to identify relevant product opportunities
Support evaluation and prioritization of strategic initiatives that strengthen Moody’s Ratings’ position within evolving digital financial markets
Translate market developments, client needs and business priorities into actionable plans, capability enhancements and roadmap inputs

Analyze stakeholder needs and emerging opportunities to support product strategy, capability development, planning and governance activities

Our Digital Economy team within Moody’s Ratings supports the firm’s strategy for innovative technologies including digital assets, tokenization, decentralized finance, stablecoins, on-chain infrastructure and data-driven innovation. The Technical Product Owner for Veeva QMS will play a key role in the global implementation and adoption of Veeva Quality Management System capabilities within VISION. The position bridges business quality processes and IT solution delivery, ensuring that requirements from Qual-ity, Manufacturing, Regulatory, and related business functions are translated into scalable, compliant, and harmonized system capabilities. The role requires a strong understanding of regulated environments such as healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical device, and GxP-relevant industries, including quality system expectations under standards and frameworks such as ISO 13485, and applicable GxP requirements.
Primary duties and responsibilities :
Act as Technical Product Owner for the implementation, rollout, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Veeva QMS capabilities within VISION;
Translate business requirements from Quality Management, Manufacturing, Laboratory, Regulatory, and GxP-relevant stakeholders into clear functional and technical product backlog items
Define, prioritize, and manage the product backlog, including user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and release priorities in alignment with business value, compliance, and inspection-readiness needs;
Support process and solution design for core QMS processes such as deviations, CAPA, change control, audits, complaints, document control, training, quality events, and management oversight activities
Ensure effective integration and data alignment between Veeva QMS and relevant enterprise systems, especially SAP QM, LIMS, MES, ERP, and related manufacturing or quality platforms;
Collaborate with implementation partners, internal IT teams, business process owners, validation teams, and regional/local quality representatives to deliver fit-for-purpose solutions for healthcare, pharma, medical technology, and medical device environments
Support configuration, testing, validation, migration, cut-over, deployment, hyper care, and transition to support activities for Veeva QMS implementation waves
Ensure that implemented solutions comply with applicable quality, regulatory, CSV, data integrity, internal governance, ISO 13485, MDSAP, and GxP requirements where applicable
Contribute to preparation, support, and follow-up of certification audits, regulatory authority inspections, TÜV audits, and internal/external quality system assessments from a system and process perspective
Contribute to training concepts, knowledge transfer, documentation, change management, and management reporting on relevant QMS indicators to drive adoption of the Veeva QMS solution across VISION.
Transfers BPO-defined or BPO-approved demands into complete technical specifications.
Adds technical product requirements such as scalability, security, and extensibility and communicates them to the BPO.
Coordinates the effort estimation of fully specified requirements.
Checks the technical feasibility and completeness of demands.
Manages prioritized requirements in the demand funnel and ensures a sufficiently maintained development backlog.
Ensures that only fully specified demands are handed over to development as user stories.
Coordinates the development and development testing process
Ensuring that defined acceptance criteria have been tested and fulfilled.
Maintains the work breakdown structure of defined tasks.
Hands over releases with completed user stories to the BPO for approval.
Prioritizes and defines technical requirements and tasks in alignment with the BPO.
Manages and communicates technical requirements towards the BPO.
Ensure transparent reporting on progress against planned work and agreed delivery dates.
Escalates delays and risks proactively to the BPO.
Supports the BPO in analyzing reported failures and making informed product decisions.
Job Specifications
1. Education / Professional Certification
University degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Quality Management, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or an equivalent qualification.
2. Experience
More than 10 years of relevant professional experience in SAP QM, LIMS, QMS systems, quality process digitalization, or regulated system implementation within healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical device, or other GxP-relevant environments; experience with Veeva QMS is strongly preferred.
3. Skills:
Strong functional and technical understanding of Quality Management processes and systems, preferably including Veeva QMS, SAP QM, LIMS, and related enterprise platforms;
Proven experience as Product Owner, Business Process Owner, Solution Lead, or Senior Business Expert in global QMS, ERP, or laboratory system implementation programs;
Experience with end-to-end implementation activities including requirements engineering, solution design, backlog management, configuration support, testing, validation, deployment, and hyper care;
Good understanding of regulated environments, computerized system validation, GxP expectations, data integrity principles, quality compliance requirements, and relevant certification standards such as ISO 13485 and MDSAP;
Ability to read, understand, and interpret regulatory and quality requirements and trans-late them into practical business processes, system requirements, and implementation priorities;
Ability to connect business process needs with technical solution capabilities and to communicate effectively with both business and IT stakeholders;
Experience in integrating QMS processes with SAP QM, MES, LIMS, document management, training, and reporting solutions is an advantage;
Structured, analytical, and result-oriented working style with the ability to manage complexity, dependencies, and multiple stakeholder expectations in an international environment;
Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written; German or other languages are an advantage.

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description

4-8 years exp

Analyzes business systems, processes, and related data to determine how solutions can be engineered to provided new or improved business capabilities and/or processes. Acts as a member of a product team responsible for the translation of business terms and processes into technical requirements, specifications, and/or acceptance criteria. Function as a proxy product owner and subject matter expert for their various business domains. Core competencies included requirements engineering, requirements elicitation, processes modeling, and workshop facilitation. Prepares communications and makes presentations on system enhancements and/or alternatives.

Provides specific functional expertise that is theoretical and conceptual in nature. This expertise is typically acquired through a combination of university education and experience within a field. May have responsibility for supervising others in the capacity of a “player coach” but primary focus is individual expertise. Particularly at higher levels, sophisticated subject matter expertise is a requirement for success.

Applies working knowledge and experience in own job discipline. Continues to broaden capabilities and understanding of the company, processes and customers. Solves problems in straightforward situations by analyzing possible solutions using experience, judgment, and precedents. Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team. Performs a range of assignments with a moderate level of guidance and direction.

Strategy Development and Implementation

Analyzes financial and market situations and participates in the creation of a business case or part of a business strategy.
Applies/integrates the business strategy to work of own team, understanding the main goals of the organization.
Analyzes data to provide information to stakeholders on strategic issues; provides information to facilitate the calculation of the ROI.

Stakeholder Engagement

Identifies and manages key business partner relationships, listens to and understands their needs and expectations, maintains open two-way communication and delivers value to business partner. Maintains, facilitates, and improves upon those relationships and demonstrates accountability for results. Develops trust and influence among key business partners. Is available and consistently communicates with business partners to reach desired goals in a timely manner, showing flexibility when needed.

Process Improvement

Assesses bottlenecks in work processes within teams to streamline and simplify workflow.
Coordinates with team members to execute new ideas or approaches and achieve process improvement goals.
Compiles data and analyzes the impact of process changes.

Technical Communication/Presentation

Confirms comprehension and understanding of complex information (e.g., legal, operational risk, and regulatory data) by correctly and clearly answering routine questions.
Creates clear, concise and organized communication materials (e.g., policies & procedures, guidelines, presentations, messages).
Considers and understands the audience’s specific needs and comprehension level to determine the most appropriate message and delivery method, limiting or explaining technical language.

Building a Business Case

Articulates the presenting business issue impacting own team and helps develop the rationale for addressing it (e.g., impact on customer satisfaction scores or team revenues).
Assists in the identification and analysis (e.g., cost/benefit, risk) of potential solutions to address the business need.
Helps determine the recommended solution, documenting the business case for change and sharing with team leadership.

Project Management

Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.
Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.
Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
5. Pixel, India s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.
We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.
If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.
If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here . You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn , Instagram, YouTube , and X .
About the Product
Zeta is building a new consumer banking product for the US market. The focus is learning fast which features drive adoption, engagement and retention - and building them well.
About the Role
Youll help grow the product through a steady cadence of experiments and feature launches. Each PM owns a business-outcome metric for one area of the product, and the roadmap that moves it. Example areas: onboarding and activation, engagement and retention, revenue, and trust and risk.
We need a hustler. The work will feel like a very early-stage startup: ambiguous problems, incomplete information, shifting priorities and no playbook. Youll bring structure to the chaos: find the answers, make the calls and get things shipped.
We expect PMs to use AI tools across the lifecycle - research, specs, prototyping, analysis - to keep iteration cycles short. PMs here go deep on how things are built, so hands-on software development experience is mandatory.
Responsibilities
1. Own a metric
  • Own a business-outcome metric for your area, plus the guardrail metrics it must not trade away.
  • Keep a ranked backlog of experiments and features, prioritised by expected impact (RICE, ICE or similar).
2. Run experiments
  • Write each bet as a hypothesis with a primary metric, guardrails and a decision rule, all set before launch.
  • Match the method to the traffic: A/B tests and holdouts at scale; fake doors, usability tests and cohort analysis at low volume.
  • Size tests properly, report null and negative results as plainly as wins, and make the ship, iterate or kill call.
  • Keep a running log of what was tested, what was learned and what changed.
3. Build features
  • Take features from problem definition through spec, build, QA, launch and adoption.
  • Write specs engineers can build from: flows, edge cases, failure states, event instrumentation and acceptance criteria.
  • Work through technical design with engineering - APIs, data models, ledger and payment flows, third-party integrations - and make trade-off calls quickly.
4. Measure
  • Define output metrics (acquisition, activation, revenue, engagement) and the input metrics that drive them (funnel conversion, feature usage).
  • Own event instrumentation and data quality for your area.
  • Do your own analysis in SQL, product analytics tools (such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or MoEngage) and BI tools (such as Metabase or Superset).
5. Research users
  • Run continuous discovery with US customers through remote interviews, usability tests and surveys.
  • Turn what you hear and what the data shows into clear problem statements that feed the backlog.
6. Shape the UX
  • Partner with designers on simple flows that earn users trust.
  • Own product copy for your area.
7. Launch and support
  • Ship behind feature flags and in stages, with monitoring and a rollback plan.
  • Work with compliance, risk, banking partners, operations and support so every launch meets regulatory requirements and can be supported from day one.
Skills
  • Statistics and experiment design: hypothesis testing, significance, power and sample sizing, and common traps such as peeking and novelty effects.
  • Strong SQL, and fluency with product analytics and BI tools.
  • Ability to work through messy data sets and turn them into decisions.
  • Engineering fundamentals you still use: reading code, system design, APIs and data models.
  • A keen eye for design, and strong UX writing.
  • Clear written and verbal communication - specs and experiment readouts people can act on.
  • Meticulous program management across parallel workstreams.

It gives our customers a native way to create, publish and sell events — in-person, online and hybrid — with ticketing, RSVPs, paid and free registration, and attendee management, sitting directly alongside the contacts, communities, courses, credentials and automations they already run their business on. Own and Shape the B2C & Events Roadmap Partner with product leadership to help shape and execute the roadmap for HighLevel's B2C platform, serving 1.1M+ monthly active learners, with a focus on engagement, completion, and retention in a B2B2C environment.

Close the Table-Stakes Gap, Then Go Past It – Know the category cold. Take Events from Beta to GA – Own the beta exit criteria: the quality bar, the reliability bar, the feature completeness, and the adoption and revenue signals that tell us this product is ready to be sold broadly. Drive the program that closes those gaps.

Build Ticketing, Checkout and Payments – Lead paid, free and RSVP event types, multi-tier and multi-currency ticketing, checkout conversion, discounts, taxes, refunds and payouts — with the precision and trust a revenue-bearing flow demands, and with fee and payout terms that are a reason to choose us rather than a reason to resent us.

Give Organizers Ownership of Their Audience – Build the capability that most defines us against the category: every registration flows into the organizer's own CRM, segmentable, automatable and theirs to keep. Own Event-Day Operations – Events are judged on the day they happen. Own check-in and QR scanning, offline resilience at the door, guest lists and comp tickets, on-site sales, capacity enforcement and the operational tooling organizers depend on when things go wrong in real time.

Own the Attendee Experience in Client Portal – Client Portal is where the attendee side of Events lives, and you own it: how members find what is on, register and check out, hold their tickets, receive reminders and joining links, attend in person or online, and look back at what they have been to. Deliver that journey across both web and mobile, make events feel native to the portal rather than bolted onto it, and hold a phone-first bar throughout.

Drive Distribution and Discovery – Shape how events get found and filled: SEO-ready event pages, social and calendar syndication, embeddable listings, the Gokollab Marketplace, and the promotion tooling that turns an organizer's existing audience into attendance.

Open the Platform – Treat APIs, webhooks and integrations as a first-class surface rather than a premium upsell, so agencies and developers can build events into the workflows and client solutions they already sell.

Champion UI/UX Excellence – Partner closely with design and engineering to deliver interfaces that are intuitive, accessible, mobile-friendly and fast — for both the organizer building an event and the attendee registering for one.

Talk to Organizers Constantly – Run discovery with beta organizers, sit in on their setup, watch where they stall, and turn qualitative signal into a prioritized backlog. At this stage, direct customer contact is a primary input, not a supplement.

Experiment and Optimize – Design and analyze experiments across the funnel — event page conversion, registration completion, checkout drop-off, organizer onboarding — and iterate rapidly on evidence rather than opinion.

Support Scale, Reliability and Trust – Drive the platform work a live-event product demands: registration integrity, capacity and waitlist correctness, payment reliability, fraud and listing trust, and graceful behavior under the traffic spikes that come with a popular event going on sale.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Work across engineering, design, data, support, marketing and customer-facing teams to launch features, drive adoption, and close the loop on organizer feedback.

Define and Own the Metrics – Establish the success metrics for a product that does not yet have them — organizer activation, time to first published event, repeat-event rate, registration and checkout conversion, attendance rate, gross ticket volume and revenue per organizer — set the OKRs against them, and use them to steer the roadmap.

Deliver Outcomes, Not Just Features – Be accountable for measurable growth in events published, organizers activated, registrations processed and ticket revenue running through the platform.

WHO YOU ARE

B2C Experience – You have built and shipped impactful features for B2C platforms or content products, creating engaging end user experiences that drive activation, completion, and retention at meaningful scale.

An End-to-End Owner – You are comfortable owning the entire life of an event across two connected surfaces: the creator experience in the Memberships admin, where an organizer builds, prices, publishes, promotes and runs their event, and the attendee experience in Client Portal, where a member discovers it, registers, attends and looks back on it. You think in terms of the whole journey and the handoffs between those surfaces, not in terms of screens.

UX-Attentive for Learning – You bring a strong UI/UX sensibility focused on learner journeys, content discovery, progress tracking, and habit formation, with a track record of delivering intuitive and high-quality learning experiences.

jobs.sourceTitle: Director, Product Management — Core Database Engine & AI
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will lead product strategy and execution for Teradata's core database engine: the massively parallel query engine behind every workload on the platform. You will shape the roadmap across the optimizer, execution runtime, workload management, and Global Planner, and own how the engine performs on native storage, cloud object storage, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake.

This role sits at the intersection of the database engine and AI. AI agents are becoming the dominant consumers of enterprise data, issuing high volumes of exploratory, speculative queries, while GenAI and machine learning can improve the engine from the inside. Every core component needs to be rethought in this light, and you will lead that rethink and turn it into a roadmap engineering can build.

Two things anchor the role. Performance: you will spend significant time inside real workloads, query plans, and benchmarks, working with engineering to deliver measurable gains release after release. SQL: you will be the steward of Teradata SQL, the surface customers live in, making its syntax, semantics, and ergonomics simpler, more expressive, and safer for developers, analysts, and AI agents.

Strategy: Own the engine vision and multi-year roadmap, co-owning architecture direction with senior engineering leaders and making principled trade-offs across performance, cost, and complexity.
AI and agents: Lead the rethink of every core engine component for AI agents as the new dominant workload, and apply GenAI and ML inside the engine to make it faster and more autonomous.
Optimizer, execution, and workload management: Agents send many redundant queries. Explore optimizing across queries, sharing intermediate results, and returning early or approximate answers. Apply learned cardinality and cost models and LLM-assisted rewrite, with guardrails that protect plan stability. Define how workload management absorbs bursty machine traffic through agent identity, priorities, and budgets.
Performance: Work hands-on with engineering on query plans, regressions, and bottlenecks. Own the benchmark suite and KPIs (latency, concurrency, plan stability, price-performance), including agentic workloads, and build regression gates into releases.
Open Table formats: Own the engine side of Iceberg and Delta Lake (scan planning, pruning, pushdown, write paths) so customers never trade performance for openness. Automate statistics, clustering, and compaction with AI.
SQL language and query interface: Design features that turn complex problems into simple, readable queries, reduce footguns while keeping power and backward compatibility, and stay aligned with ANSI SQL. Make the dialect something agents can safely generate and execute, and let agents steer with cost estimates, plan explanations, and hints.

Who You'll Work With

You will work with senior database engineering leaders, performance engineering, AI platform teams, the open table format product team, sales engineering, and executive leadership across the US, Europe, and India. This role starts as an individual contributor, leading through technical depth and influence and mentoring Staff-level PMs. It may grow into managing a team of product managers.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

15+ years in databases, query engines, or distributed data systems, including senior product management or equivalent principal or staff engineering experience
Expert understanding of database internals: query planning, cost-based optimization, execution models, and MPP trade-offs
Deep SQL expertise: a heavy SQL user (data engineer, analyst, or DBA) with strong opinions on language design, ergonomics, and compatibility
A hands-on performance mindset: reading query plans, designing benchmarks, and finding root causes with senior engineers
A strong working understanding of LLMs and AI agents, and an informed view on how they change database design and how ML can improve database internals
Architecture-level knowledge of Snowflake, Databricks, and ClickHouse, and fluency in lakehouse architecture and open table formats
Degree in Computer Science or a related field; an MS or PhD in databases, distributed systems, or ML for systems is a plus

What You'll Bring

First-principles thinking and good taste: willingness to question long-standing database assumptions, a preference for elegance over verbosity, customer obsession, daily use of GenAI tools, and the credibility to earn the trust of senior engineers
The ability to read research critically, separate promise from hype, and design experiments to prove value, with a track record of setting multi-year platform strategy
A plus: experience designing SQL features or language extensions, hands-on work with optimizers or learned database components, open-source contributions, or publications at SIGMOD, VLDB, or CIDR

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Why Join Us?

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices, it gives users greater control over their data and how they use artificial intelligence. Our focus is on local, on-device, and privacy-preserving AI, with opportunities to connect these experiences across Tether’s peer-to-peer ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong interest in AI and a practical understanding of how to turn emerging capabilities into useful products.

You will work closely with the Product Lead to help advance the QV.AC vision: identifying valuable use cases, defining AI features, exploring product concepts, and working with engineering and design to bring them to users. You’ll contribute to product direction and take responsibility for moving assigned features from discovery through delivery and iteration.

This role suits someone who knows how to leverage AI to the maximum and enjoys experimenting with new AI technologies, understands its possibilities and limitations, and cares about making complex technology easy to use.

Responsibilities

Help shape AI features: Work with the Product Lead to translate the QV.AC vision into concrete use cases, feature proposals, and product requirements. Bring ideas grounded in user needs, research, and hands-on experimentation.
Understand users and their problems: Gather feedback, conduct research, and explore how people use AI in their everyday workflows. Identify where AI can solve a meaningful problem and where a simpler solution may work better.
Turn ideas into clear specifications: Write product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user flows that help engineering and design understand the intended experience, constraints, and measures of success.
Prototype and explore: Create wireframes, mockups, and working prototypes to test ideas and communicate product behavior. Use AI-assisted tools to explore concepts quickly and refine them with the team.
Collaborate on technical trade-offs: Work with engineers to understand what is feasible across devices and models. Help assess the impact of response quality, latency, memory usage, battery consumption, and privacy on the user experience.
Support prioritization and planning: Help the Product Lead evaluate opportunities, clarify scope, identify dependencies, and maintain a focused backlog aligned with product priorities.
Drive feature delivery: Follow assigned features through development, resolve product questions, review the experience, and coordinate feedback and release readiness with relevant teams.
Stay close to AI developments: Explore new AI products, models, tools, and interaction patterns, and explain their practical relevance to QV.AC. Share clear recommendations about what is worth testing or adopting and why.

Mandatory:

7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on AI software products with technical engineering teams.
Practical experience building, shipping, or prototyping AI-powered features, with the ability to explain your contribution and what you learned.
A working understanding of AI concepts such as inference, harnesses, model capabilities and limitations, context, and evaluation, alongside an interest in local and on-device AI.
The ability to translate an ambiguous idea into a clear user problem, proposed solution, and actionable requirements.
Strong product judgment, with attention to usability, scope, and measurable user value.
Confidence creating prototypes using design or coding tools
Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers and explain them to non-technical colleagues.
A proactive, collaborative approach: comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions early, and incorporating feedback.
Familiarity with product analytics, user research, and iterative software development.

Preferred:

Experience with local AI, on-device inference, or open-source models.
Experience building AI assistants, conversational interfaces, or multimodal features.
Familiarity with desktop or mobile product development.
An understanding of peer-to-peer technologies and decentralized applications.
Experience evaluating AI output quality and designing user experiences that account for uncertainty and errors.
Experience working in a distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.
Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.
Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.
Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.
Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.
Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.
Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

Mandatory:

5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)
3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry
Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.
Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.
Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.
Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.
Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.
Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.
Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
