Our platform brings together learning, memberships, webinars, recruitment, institutional groups, and user support across an interconnected WordPress Multisite ecosystem.

*Role Overview*

We are looking for a hands-on *Associate Product Manager* to manage platform operations, translate business requirements into actionable tasks, coordinate engineers, and ensure reliable feature delivery.

*You will report directly to the Founder*, who sets the product vision and business priorities. You will turn those priorities into clear requirements, configurations, test scenarios, and delivery schedules.

This role requires strong WordPress Multisite knowledge and the ability to understand complete user journeys across interconnected modules. Custom coding is handled by platform engineers.

*Key Responsibilities*

*1. WordPress Multisite Administration*

* Manage network-level and individual subsite configurations within a subdirectory-based WordPress Multisite setup.
* Understand network-activated versus site-specific plugins, shared users, site-level roles, permissions, and cross-site access.
* Configure pages, menus, plugin settings, shortcodes, and approved platform features.
* Maintain consistent user experiences across the main site and subsites.
* Assess the impact of configuration or plugin changes across the network before release.

*2. Platform Modules & Workflows*

Administer, configure, and test the following modules and their connected workflows:

ModuleOperational Scope*LifterLMS*Course and lesson structures, categories, quizzes, enrollments, learner progress, and access rules*BuddyPress*Member profiles, activity feeds, college/company groups, group membership, and moderation*Events Manager*Webinar and event listings, registrations, bookings, attendee records, and communications*WP Job Manager*Job listings, employer submissions, and connected candidate application workflows*Paid Memberships Pro*Membership levels, subscriptions, checkout, renewals, and membership-based access*myCRED*Points, earning rules, balances, and engagement workflows*Fluent Support*Support tickets, categorization, assignment, escalation, and resolution tracking*Registration & Access*LinkedIn login, first-time user onboarding, profile completion, and custom page/membership gating*Video & Media*Vimeo lesson playback and media delivery through WP Offload Media Lite and Amazon S3*Custom Platform Features*Placement workflows, certificate issuance and verification, profile integration, and issue reporting as these features are introduced

* Understand how actions in one module affect permissions, records, notifications, and user experiences elsewhere.
* Keep participation certificates separate from professional credentials in requirements and workflows.

*3. Product Requirements & Founder Coordination*

* Work directly with the Founder to clarify business requirements and agree priorities.
* Translate ideas into user stories, workflow descriptions, business rules, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Maintain an organized product backlog with clear scope, ownership, dependencies, and deadlines.
* Identify gaps and usability problems; recommend practical improvements.
* Escalate decisions affecting scope, cost, priorities, or delivery commitments to the Founder.

*4. Engineer Coordination & Delivery Planning*

* Coordinate day-to-day work with a small team of platform engineers.
* Ensure engineers have complete requirements and clearly defined expected outcomes.
* Run brief progress reviews, track blockers, and verify completed work.
* Maintain rolling *1-week, 2-week, and 1-month look-ahead schedules*.
* Provide the Founder with a concise weekly update covering delivery progress, outstanding defects, risks, and decisions required.

*5. Hands-On Quality Assurance*

* Write and execute use cases, test cases, and end-to-end testing scenarios.
* Test journeys for students, professionals, college coordinators, employers, instructors, and administrators.
* Verify registration, login, memberships, payments, course access, event bookings, group access, job applications, and support workflows.
* Test failed transactions, expired access, incorrect permissions, duplicate submissions, and other exception scenarios.
* Conduct regression, mobile, and cross-browser checks on staging before release.
* Record bugs with reproduction steps, screenshots, severity, and expected versus actual results.
* Provide functional acceptance against agreed criteria and perform post-release checks.

*6. Connected Architecture & Reliability*

* Understand the operational relationship between the *Next.js front end and WordPress back end*, including Cloudflare-hosted front-end delivery and API-driven workflows.
* Coordinate checks for caching, content synchronization, authentication, media delivery, and integration failures.
* Monitor available uptime, performance, error, and transaction dashboards.
* Coordinate incident investigation and resolution with engineers.
* Track plugin updates, compatibility issues, security alerts, and maintenance activities.
* Confirm backup and rollback readiness with engineers before significant releases.

Engineers remain responsible for custom code, technical deployment, server administration, and infrastructure remediation.

*7. Documentation, Support & Improvement*

* Maintain configuration records, module inventories, operating procedures, test repositories, and release notes.
* Help internal teams use platform features correctly.
* Review support tickets to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities.
* Track agreed indicators such as registration completion, enrollment success, booking success, unresolved defects, and support resolution times.

*Required Skills & Experience*

* *4–7 years of relevant experience* across platform operations, WordPress administration, product delivery, QA, or technical project coordination.
* *Strong hands-on WordPress Multisite knowledge is essential*, including network administration, subsites, shared users, roles, and plugin activation scope.
* Practical experience administering an LMS, membership, community, recruitment, or comparable multi-module platform.
* Ability to configure features through administration interfaces without relying on developers for every routine change.
* Strong testing discipline and experience documenting requirements, acceptance criteria, and reproducible bugs.
* Experience coordinating developers and managing work through tools such as Jira, Trello, Asana, or ClickUp.
* Working understanding of APIs, databases, DNS, caching, staging, production, backups, and access control.
* Clear written communication, structured planning, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

*Preferred Experience*

* Direct experience with several of the plugins listed above, particularly *LifterLMS, BuddyPress, WooCommerce, and Paid Memberships Pro*.
* WordPress Multisite platforms connected to a separate front end.
* Payment gateways, transactional emails, LinkedIn authentication, Zoom, Vimeo, and Amazon S3.
* Familiarity with hosting dashboards and concepts such as Docker, Portainer, Nginx, MariaDB, and Redis.
* Experience in education, professional learning, recruitment, or community platforms.

*What Success Looks Like*

* The Founder

Product Manager - myRico

HSR, Bangalore, India

Mission

The best teams spend too much time keeping work moving. Context is scattered across conversations, documents and tools. Decisions get lost. Dependencies go unnoticed. Someone has to remember what matters, connect the dots and follow through.

We’re building myRico to help carry that work.

Our ambition is an AI teammate that understands your company—its goals, people, decisions and ways of working—and uses that understanding to help the team get things done. A teammate that earns trust through useful work, sound judgment and dependable follow-through.

Our starting point is helping software teams move projects from intent to delivery. Success means less effort spent coordinating and correcting work, and a shorter path to an outcome the team can stand behind.

The role

We’re hiring our founding Product Manager to help turn that ambition into a product that teams rely on every day.

You’ll work closely with the founders, engineers and early customers to figure out where Rico creates the most value, what we should build next and whether it actually works. You’ll own the loop from understanding a problem to shipping a solution, watching people use it and making it better.

Some of the hardest questions are also the most interesting. When should Rico act on its own? When should it ask? What should it remember? How does it earn permission to take on more responsibility? How do we know it has saved someone time once we account for the effort of directing, reviewing and correcting it?

In practice, you might spend a morning watching a customer run a project, prototype a better workflow that afternoon, and work with engineering to put it in their hands that week. You’ll read conversations, investigate failures, challenge assumptions and make the small product decisions that determine whether an AI teammate feels useful or exhausting.

You’ll help shape both the product and how we build it. That means choosing a few problems worth solving deeply, making clear tradeoffs and staying accountable for what happens after launch.

This role is based in Bangalore and would require 5 days in office.

What we’re looking for

Customer obsession. You get close enough to users to understand how their work actually happens, including the workarounds they’ve stopped noticing.

Product judgment. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear decision about what to build, what to leave out and what evidence would change your mind.

A builder’s instinct. You use prototypes, experiments and AI tools to make ideas tangible and learn quickly.

Technical fluency. You can reason with engineers about AI behavior, memory, integrations, permissions and the tradeoffs between quality, latency and cost.

Care for the details. You notice when an interaction creates confusion, a notification interrupts at the wrong time or a confident answer hasn’t earned that confidence.

Ownership. You follow a problem through discovery, delivery and adoption. You stay with it when the first solution falls short.

Clear communication. You write precisely, explain your reasoning and disagree thoughtfully.

Experience

You’ve helped take a product or meaningful feature from an unclear problem to real usage. You can explain the decisions you made, the tradeoffs you accepted and what you learned when users surprised you.

Your background might be product management, engineering, design or founding a company. We care about evidence of good judgment and useful things you’ve shipped.

This role will be a poor fit if

You need a fully defined roadmap before you can make progress.

You prefer handing off requirements to staying involved through implementation and adoption.

You’re uncomfortable spending substantial time with customers or examining where the product fails.

You find it difficult to change direction when the evidence challenges your original idea.

Bonus

You’ve built an AI product and dealt with its behavior in real use.

You’ve worked on collaboration tools, developer products or complex business workflows.

You’ve been a founder or an early employee at a startup.

You can build working prototypes yourself.

About Tala

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

The Role

Tala is on a mission to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We’re building financial services that give people greater access, control, and agency over their financial lives.

As Tala continues to scale, protecting our customers while creating a seamless experience is more important than ever. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication to lead the strategy and execution of the systems that keep our customers and platform safe.

As the Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication, you’ll own Tala’s product strategy for fraud prevention, customer authentication, and identity-related experiences across the customer journey.

You’ll tackle complex problems at the intersection of fraud, risk, machine learning, data, engineering, and customer experience.

Your goal will be to help Tala identify and prevent fraudulent activity while minimizing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Legal, and other global teams to turn complex fraud patterns and ambiguous problems into scalable products and systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems with data, moving quickly, and building products that have a measurable impact on both customers and the business.

What You'll Do
Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy
Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.
Build Data-Driven Fraud Products
Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.
Lead Product Execution
Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.
Partner with Engineering to understand Tala’s fraud and authentication infrastructure and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
Drive initiatives from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.
Manage Fraud & Risk Events
Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Operations to investigate fraud incidents and emerging fraud patterns.
Turn lessons from fraud events into proactive product and system improvements.
Develop approaches that allow Tala to respond quickly as fraud patterns and attack vectors evolve.
Collaborate Across Tala
Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, and Legal.
Communicate complex fraud and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners supporting fraud, authentication, identity, or risk capabilities.
Create alignment across distributed global teams and drive decisions in an environment where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.
What You'll Need
5+ years of Product Management experience, with experience owning complex technical products or platforms.
Proven experience building or managing products related to fraud, risk, authentication, identity, KYC, account security, payments, lending, or financial crime.
Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science to build fraud detection, risk decisioning, authentication, or identity solutions.
Experience using data and metrics to make product decisions and measure outcomes.
Experience managing fraud incidents, emerging fraud patterns, or other high-impact risk events.
Ability to translate complex and ambiguous problems into clear product requirements and actionable roadmaps.
Experience managing external vendors or technology partners.
Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, distributed, and highly collaborative environment.
